places.name: Zeughauskeller
places.near: About a 10-minute walk south from Zurich HB (main station) down Bahnhofstrasse; or tram 6, 7, 11, or 13 to Paradeplatz, then a 2-minute walk. Just off Bahnhofstrasse beside Paradeplatz.
places.order: Grilled sausages (Kalbsbratwurst, Bauernbratwurst with the giant 'Kanonenputzer' sabre sausage), Zürcher Kalbsgeschnetzeltes with Rösti, Schweinshaxe (pork knuckle), Cordon Bleu, and local beer.
places.notes: Iconic, reliably busy Zurich classic — confirmed open in 2026; best for a fun, casual, authentically Swiss meal rather than fine dining. · v1 POI Finder
places.famousFor: Bustling 15th-century former armoury turned beer hall near Paradeplatz, serving hearty Swiss classics at long communal wooden tables since 1926 — a Zurich institution for locals and tourists alike.
places.goodToKnow: Open daily 11:30–23:00 (warm kitchen to 22:00). Very popular and often full — reserve ahead for dinner or arrive early; expect to share tables. Large, lively, family-friendly; generous portions. Cash and cards accepted. Great for atmosphere photos of the vaulted hall and antique weaponry.

places.name: Swiss Chuchi Restaurant
places.near: About a 10–12 minute walk from Zurich HB across the Limmat into Niederdorf; or tram 4 or 15 to Rathaus, then a 3-minute walk. On Rosengasse, just off Niederdorfstrasse.
places.order: Cheese fondue (9 variations, including the Adler Special), Raclette, Zürcher Geschnetzeltes (veal fricassée), and chocolate fondue for dessert.
places.notes: Dependable, atmospheric fondue experience in a prime old-town location — confirmed open in 2026; touristy but consistently well-reviewed for classic fondue. · v1 POI Finder
places.famousFor: The first fondue parlour in Zurich's old town (serving since 1953), inside Hotel Adler in the lively Niederdorf pedestrian zone — a go-to, very tourist-popular spot for classic Swiss cheese dishes.
places.goodToKnow: Hot food daily 11:30–23:15 (kitchen to ~22:00); weekends open from 12:00. Reservations strongly recommended, especially evenings and weekends. Family-friendly and central; can be busy and touristy at peak dinner hours. Cosy alpine-chalet interior makes good photos.

places.name: Restaurant Kronenhalle
places.near: About a 12–15 minute walk from Zurich HB along the river to Bellevue; or tram 2, 4, 8, 9, 11, or 15 to Bellevue, then a 1–2 minute walk. On Rämistrasse near Bellevueplatz and the Opera House.
places.order: The legendary Kronenhalle sliced veal filet (Zürcher Geschnetzeltes) with Rösti, Kronenhalle ravioli with prawns and white curry, home-made Balleron salad, and the apple cake from Hulda Zumsteg's original recipe.
places.notes: One of Zurich's most storied fine-dining rooms — confirmed operating in 2026 under the Gustav Zumsteg Foundation; book ahead and expect a formal, classic experience. · v1 POI Finder
places.famousFor: Legendary Zurich institution open since 1924, world-famous for its original art collection (Chagall, Picasso, Miró, Bonnard, Matisse) hanging on the walls, paired with classic Swiss home-style cooking. A true see-and-be-seen landmark.
places.goodToKnow: Restaurant open daily 12:00–24:00 (kitchen to 22:30); the adjoining bar is a famous cocktail destination. Reservations essential (phone +41 44 262 99 00 or online); smart dress expected. Upscale pricing. The art makes it worth a visit even for a drink at the bar; photography is discreet — respect other guests.

places.name: Haus Hiltl
places.near: About a 7–10 minute walk from Zurich HB south down Bahnhofstrasse, then a short turn onto Sihlstrasse; or tram 6, 7, 11, or 13 to Rennweg/Paradeplatz area, then a short walk. Corner building near Bahnhofstrasse.
places.order: The legendary Hiltl buffet (weigh-and-pay, 100+ hot and cold dishes — mushroom stroganoff, Thai and Indian curries, Middle Eastern mezze), plus à la carte veg classics; there is also Switzerland's first vegetarian butchery on site.
places.notes: A must-visit Zurich icon and pioneer of vegetarian dining — confirmed open in 2026 (Yelp reviews updated July 2026); consistently well-reviewed and great value via the buffet. · v1 POI Finder
places.famousFor: The world's oldest vegetarian restaurant (founded 1898), recognized by Guinness World Records; family-run into its fourth generation. Famous for its huge pay-by-weight buffet of 100+ international veg and vegan dishes.
places.goodToKnow: Open long hours daily (breakfast through late evening); the buffet is priced by weight, ideal for flexible portions and mixed groups. Very family- and vegan-friendly with clear allergy/vegan labelling. Reservations recommended for the served restaurant at peak lunch/dinner; the buffet and takeaway are walk-in. Also houses the Hiltl Academy (cooking classes) and a club upstairs.

places.name: Zunfthaus zur Waag
places.near: About a 10-minute walk from Zurich HB main station; or tram 4/15 to Rathaus, then a short walk. Tram 2/8/9/11 to Paradeplatz is also close. In the heart of the Old Town, pedestrian access only around Münsterhof.
places.order: Zürcher Geschnetzeltes (sliced veal in cream sauce) with butter rösti — the house signature, often called the best in town; seasonal Swiss classics and a curated wine list.
places.notes: Iconic, dependable choice for classic Zürcher Geschnetzeltes in a genuine historic guild house; confirmed open in 2026. · v1 POI Finder
places.famousFor: Elegant 700-year-old guild house (building dates to 1315) of the Linen Weavers' Guild, directly on the picturesque Münsterhof square facing the Fraumünster with its Chagall windows; refined traditional Zürich cuisine in a historic setting. Ranked among Zurich's top-15 restaurants on Tripadvisor.
places.goodToKnow: Reservations strongly recommended, especially for dinner and weekends. Open Mon–Sat 11:30–14:00 and 18:00–22:00; closed Sundays and select holidays (plus a mid-July to early-August summer break in 2026). The Münsterhof square outside makes for excellent photos. Smart-casual; upscale pricing.

places.name: Zunfthaus zur Zimmerleuten
places.area: Old Town (Altstadt), Limmatquai by the Limmat river, District 1
places.near: About a 10–12 minute walk from Zurich HB along the Limmat; or tram 4/15 to Rathaus (a 2-minute walk). Directly on the Limmatquai riverfront in the Old Town.
places.order: Cheese fondue and traditional Swiss dishes; Zürcher Geschnetzeltes with rösti; seasonal specialties. The atmospheric Küferstube and river terrace are draws in themselves.
places.notes: Confirmed rebuilt after the 2007 fire and fully open in 2026 — one of Zurich's most historic riverside dining rooms. · v1 POI Finder
places.famousFor: Grand 14th-century guild house of the carpenters' guild (Zimmerleuten) right on the Limmatquai, with a heated riverside terrace facing the Fraumünster across the water. A devastating fire in November 2007 nearly destroyed it; it was faithfully rebuilt and reopened in 2010, preserving surviving medieval timbers. Listed as a Class A national cultural property.
places.goodToKnow: Reservations recommended; upscale/relatively expensive. Restaurant open daily 11:30–14:00 and 18:00–22:30; Küferstube & terrace daily 11:30–22:30. Ask for a terrace table in warm weather for river views and photos of the Fraumünster.

places.name: Restaurant Le Dézaley Zürich
places.area: Old Town (Niederdorf), at the foot of the Grossmünster, District 1
places.near: About a 12–15 minute walk from Zurich HB into the Niederdorf; or tram 4/15 to Rathaus, then a short uphill walk toward the Grossmünster. Pedestrian Old Town lanes.
places.order: Cheese fondue (classic, or upgraded with morels, truffle or champagne); Zürcher Geschnetzeltes with rösti; Vaud specialties such as saucisson vaudois, cabbage sausage (autumn) and air-dried meats; meat fondues (Bourguignonne, Chinoise).
places.notes: Long-running, well-loved traditional fondue house; confirmed open in 2026. Address spans Römergasse 7–9 (entrance at 7). · v1 POI Finder
places.famousFor: Cozy 120-year-old institution in the Niederdorf right below the Grossmünster, celebrated for cheese fondue made to an old family recipe and for authentic specialties from the canton of Vaud (a rare Romandy touch in Zurich).
places.goodToKnow: Book ahead in autumn/winter fondue season and on weekends. Open Mon–Sat 11:30–14:00 and 18:00–24:00; closed Sundays. Fondue from about CHF 31.90 per person. Snug, traditional interior — great for a classic cold-weather fondue night; gluten-free options noted.

places.name: Riithalle
places.area: District 1, Gessnerallee on the Sihl river, near Zurich HB
places.near: About a 5-minute walk from Zurich HB main station, on the Sihl by the Gessnerallee theatre. Very central in District 1; large garage parking (600+ spaces) nearby.
places.order: Regional, seasonal Swiss and international dishes (menu changes with the season); classics with a few surprises. A relaxed spot for lunch, an after-work drink in the garden, or dinner.
places.notes: Confirmed as an active Swiss/international restaurant serving food, open in 2026; branded 'Riithalle' (Swiss-German spelling of Reithalle). · v1 POI Finder
places.famousFor: Lively restaurant set inside a heritage-protected former cavalry riding hall (Reithalle) beside the Theaterhaus Gessnerallee, with what is often called the most beautiful beer-and-wine garden in Zurich. Regional, seasonal, fresh cooking in an atmospheric industrial-historic space.
places.goodToKnow: A real, currently-open restaurant with continuous warm-kitchen service — not merely an events venue (though it also hosts events in adjacent spaces). Open long hours 7 days a week (roughly Mon–Wed 11:00–23:00, Thu–Fri 11:00–24:00, Sat 12:00–24:00, Sun 18:00–22:00; verify seasonally). The tree-shaded garden is the highlight in summer; casual and family-friendly.

places.name: Raclette Factory
places.near: About a 10-12 min walk from Zurich HB (main station) across the Limmat into Niederdorf; nearest tram stop Rathaus (trams 4, 15) is a 2-3 min walk. On Rindermarkt in the pedestrian Old Town.
places.order: Raclette (classic natürli cheese, plus flavored varieties), cheese fondue moitié-moitié, and rösti; the all-you-can-eat raclette is the signature experience.
places.notes: Confirmed open in 2026 and well reviewed; the go-to casual raclette address in the Old Town. · v1 POI Finder
places.famousFor: All-you-can-eat and à la carte raclette using natürli Zürioberland cheeses, in a cozy Alpine-chic setting in the heart of the Old Town; a relaxed, family-friendly spot to try Switzerland's classic melted-cheese dish.
places.goodToKnow: Very popular and compact — reservations strongly recommended, especially Fri/Sat evenings. Family-friendly and good for groups. Open Sun-Thu 11:30-22:00, Fri-Sat 11:30-23:00. The warm wood-and-cheese interior is photogenic. The official site lists only this Rindermarkt (Niederdorf) location; if other Zürich branches are advertised locally, confirm directly, but this is the flagship Old Town spot.

places.name: Confiserie Sprüngli | Restaurant
places.near: About a 10-min walk from Zurich HB straight down Bahnhofstrasse to Paradeplatz; or take tram 6, 7, 8, 11 or 13 to Paradeplatz — the café is right on the square.
places.order: Luxemburgerli macarons (buy an assorted box), hot chocolate, Grand Cru truffles, pralines, and a slice of cake or a light lunch in the café.
places.notes: Confirmed open in 2026 — an iconic, must-visit Zürich institution. · v1 POI Finder
places.famousFor: Zürich's most iconic confiserie since 1836 — legendary Luxemburgerli (feather-light miniature macarons), premium chocolates and truffles, and an elegant first-floor café overlooking Paradeplatz and Bahnhofstrasse. This is the famous flagship, not the Lindt & Sprüngli chocolate factory.
places.goodToKnow: Ground-floor shop for takeaway Luxemburgerli/chocolates; the Café & Restaurant is upstairs (Mon-Fri 08:30-18:30, Sat 09:00-18:30, Sun 09:00-17:00). Reservations possible for the restaurant; expect queues at peak times and on weekends. Family friendly and highly photogenic. Note Luxemburgerli are best eaten within 1-2 days.

places.name: Chäsalp
places.near: From Zurich HB take tram 5 or 6 (~12 min) to Kirche Fluntern, then bus 751 (~5 min) which stops right in front; located at the eastern edge of the city on the Zürichberg.
places.order: Cheese fondue (moitié-moitié) and raclette are the signatures; they also do charcoal-grill specialties (grilled meats, flambéed king prawns) and a Swiss brunch on weekends.
places.notes: Confirmed open in 2026; a classic destination fondue spot on the Zürichberg (note it is Witikon/Zürichberg area, not the city core). · v1 POI Finder
places.famousFor: A rustic former farmhouse and stable on the wooded Zürichberg hillside, converted into one of Zürich's best-loved traditional fondue and raclette restaurants — a genuine Alpine-style experience just outside the city.
places.goodToKnow: Reservations recommended, especially in winter fondue season and for the weekend brunch. Open Mon-Fri from 17:30, Sat-Sun and holidays from 11:30. Great for families and groups; the countryside/barn setting is atmospheric and photogenic. Slightly out of the centre — allow ~20-25 min travel each way.

places.name: Rheinfelder Bierhalle
places.near: About a 7-10 min walk from Zurich HB across the river into Niederdorf; nearest tram stop Central (trams 3, 4, 6, 7, 10, 15) is a few minutes' walk, on Niederdorfstrasse in the pedestrian Old Town.
places.order: Giant Cordon Bleu (famously oversized), schnitzel, rösti, and sausages, washed down with local draft beer.
places.notes: Confirmed open in 2026 and food-first; a beloved cheap-eats Swiss classic in the Old Town. · v1 POI Finder
places.famousFor: One of Zürich's oldest and most affordable traditional eateries (since 1870) — a bustling, no-frills beer hall serving hearty, cheap Swiss home cooking; known for enormous portions at prices well below the Zürich norm.

places.name: Ristorante Bianchi
places.near: On Limmatquai in the Old Town; ~10-min walk from Zürich HB along the Limmat, or tram 4/15 to Rathaus, steps from the door.
places.order: Linguine all'astice (lobster linguine), tartare di granchio (crab tartare), seafood risotto, fresh oysters, and the daily fresh-fish catch.
places.notes: Confirmed open in 2026; Google 4.6 (845+ reviews), official Bindella page live. · v1 POI Finder
places.famousFor: Often called the city's best seafood restaurant; fresh daily fish and shellfish on a picturesque Limmat-side terrace. 14 Gault&Millau points and Michelin Plate (2024, 2025). A Bianchi–Bindella family joint venture.
places.goodToKnow: Popular and fairly upscale — reserve ahead, especially for a terrace table in summer and for weekend dinner. Open Mon–Fri 11:30–15:00 & 18:00–23:00, Sat 11:30–23:00, Sun 12:00–22:00. Terrace over the Limmat is the photo spot; pricier than a trattoria.

places.name: Restaurant Rosso
places.area: Zürich West (Escher Wyss), Geroldstrasse / Viadukt area
places.near: In Zürich West near Hardbrücke; tram 4/17 or S-Bahn to Hardbrücke, then a short walk to Geroldstrasse. ~10–12 min by tram from Zürich HB.
places.order: Thin, crispy wood-fired pizzas (the house specialty), plus fresh pasta dishes and Italian mains from the à la carte menu.
places.notes: Confirmed open in 2026 (official site and booking live; Yelp/Tripadvisor reviews Jan–Apr 2026). Reviews are mixed (~3.8) — food-first pizzeria, not a bar. · v1 POI Finder
places.famousFor: Industrial-chic Italian in a converted 1930s warehouse with graffiti, an open fire in the middle of the room and several outdoor patios; a Zürich-West classic known for thin-crust wood-oven pizza.
places.goodToKnow: Big industrial space with buzzy vibe and patios — great for groups and casual dinners; reserve for evenings/weekends. Reservations taken weekdays from 10:00, Sat–Sun from 16:00. Service can be uneven per recent reviews, so set expectations; the fire-lit interior and outdoor terraces are the photo draws.

places.name: Bindella
places.area: Old Town (Kreis 1), In Gassen — near Paradeplatz/Bahnhofstrasse
places.near: At In Gassen, just off Bahnhofstrasse near Paradeplatz; ~8–10 min walk from Zürich HB, or tram 6/7/11/13 to Paradeplatz, then a 2-min walk.
places.order: Spaghetti all'astice (lobster spaghetti), linguine alla veneziana, fegato alla veneziana (Venetian-style calf's liver), filetto di manzo (beef fillet), paired with Italian wines.
places.notes: Confirmed open in 2026; official Bindella flagship page live, Yelp updated June 2026. · v1 POI Finder
places.famousFor: Flagship of the Bindella family in the heart of the Old Town; Venetian cuisine with fresh pasta and an extensive Italian wine list, in a stylish 'dolce vita' setting with artwork by Swiss painter Hanny Fries, steps from Paradeplatz.
places.goodToKnow: Central and popular with both locals and visitors; reservations recommended for dinner. Open Mon–Sat 11:30–23:30 (kitchen to 22:00), Sun 17:30–23:00 (kitchen to 21:00). Family-friendly but refined; good for a classic Italian dinner near Bahnhofstrasse shopping.

places.name: Santa Lucia
places.near: On Theaterstrasse right at Bellevue; tram 2/4/8/9/11/15 or S-Bahn to Bellevue/Stadelhofen, ~2-min walk. ~12 min by tram from Zürich HB.
places.order: Wood-fired pizza napoletana (the signature), fresh pasta, plus salads and Italian meat/fish classics.
places.notes: Confirmed open in 2026; official Santa Lucia (Bindella group) page live with current hours. · v1 POI Finder
places.famousFor: Well-known family-friendly pizzeria on Bellevue square (part of the Santa Lucia group, serving since 1965). Famous for crispy beech-wood-fired pizza baked ~90 seconds in a 400°C oven; a reliable, lively Zürich institution.
places.goodToKnow: Casual and kid-friendly with all-day service — no reservation needed, walk-ins welcome, so good for spontaneous or family meals. Open Sun–Thu 11:30–23:30, Fri–Sat 11:30–01:00. Central Bellevue location gets busy at peak lunch and dinner; expect a wait on weekend evenings.

places.name: Fischerstube Zürihorn
places.near: Tram 2 or 4 to Fröhlichstrasse, then a short walk to the lake; or bus 912/916 from Bellevue to Chinagarten; also reachable by lake ship to Zürichhorn. About 10-15 min from Zurich HB by tram.
places.order: Fischknusperli (crispy fried fish) with fries; Fisch-Tagesfang (daily fresh catch); goat cheese in filo pastry; cheese fondue in winter; Zurich classics.
places.notes: Scenic lakeside institution rebuilt over the water; casual-to-mid price, service can be stretched at peak times. Confirmed open (recent 2026 reviews and events). · v1 POI Finder
places.famousFor: A restaurant-village built on stilts over Lake Zurich with a 128-seat panorama terrace facing the lake, skyline, mountains and sunset; fish straight from Lake Zurich and nearby waters.
places.setting: Lakeside fish restaurant with sun terrace
places.goodToKnow: Book the Seeterrasse ahead in summer and for sunset - it is the prime spot. The complex also has a self-service Fischergarten, a take-away kiosk and an event hut, so it works for both a sit-down meal and a casual lakeside bite. Open roughly 11:30-23:30 daily. Great for lake/sunset photos.

places.name: Pumpstation
places.near: On the Utoquai lakeside promenade in Seefeld; tram 2 or 4 to Fröhlichstrasse or Feldeggstrasse, then walk to the lake; roughly 10-15 min from Zurich HB. Walkable along the shore from Bellevue.
places.order: The legendary beef skewer (Rindsspiess); grilled beef and pork sausages made to order; Härdöpfelsalat (potato salad); corn on the cob; baked potatoes.
places.notes: Food-first grill kiosk (not a bar) beloved for its lakeside location; mixed reviews on food/service but iconic atmosphere. Confirmed operating. · v1 POI Finder
places.famousFor: A former waterworks pump house turned tiny open-air grill right on the Lake Zurich promenade; long wooden benches and a relaxed Riviera feel with fantastic lake views.
places.goodToKnow: All seating is outdoors and it closes when it rains, so go on a dry day - ideally for sunset or a warm evening. Open daily midday to midnight (weather permitting). No frills, cash-friendly, casual; expect a queue and shared benches on sunny days. Food is simple but the setting is the draw.

places.name: terrasse Restaurant
places.area: Old Town / City Center (Limmatquai, by Bellevue & Niederdorf)
places.near: Limmatquai 3, right at Bellevueplatz - a hub for trams 2, 4, 8, 9, 11, 15. About a 10 min tram ride or ~15 min walk from Zurich HB along the Limmat.
places.order: Seasonal Italian-Mediterranean dishes (fresh pasta and Mediterranean mains); popular weekday business lunch; Sunday brunch; seasonal and dessert menus (chef Jean-Luc Boutilly).
places.notes: Food-first Bindella restaurant (bar is secondary); reliable Italian-Mediterranean cooking in a landmark setting. Confirmed open (2026 reviews). · v1 POI Finder
places.famousFor: One of Zurich's most beautiful freestanding buildings, set between the Limmat River and the Niederdorf; light-filled halls, high ceilings and a garden terrace by the water. Part of the respected Bindella group.
places.goodToKnow: Reserve for the terrace in good weather and for the popular Sunday brunch (10:00-14:00). Restaurant open Mon-Thu 11:30-23:00, Fri-Sat 11:30-24:00, Sun 14:15-23:00; a separate bar runs later. Central and buzzy - great for a riverside lunch or apéro before dinner. It does have a bar, but it is food-first.

places.name: CLOUDS
places.near: Maagplatz 5, next to Zürich Hardbrücke station (S-Bahn); tram 4 or 17 to Schiffbau/Technopark, or ~5 min from Hardbrücke. About 8-10 min from Zurich HB by S-Bahn to Hardbrücke, then a short walk.
places.order: Bistro: fresh breakfasts, changing lunch specials, warm and cold evening plates; Sunday brunch buffet (croissants, oysters, tartare, ~CHF 69-79); bar cocktails made with the house's own gold-awarded gin.
places.notes: Included as food-first via the Bistro, which serves proper meals all day; the separate fine-dining Kitchen is currently closed. Best for the panorama. (Needs verification of Kitchen reopening date.) · v1 POI Finder
places.famousFor: Switzerland's highest restaurant, on the 35th floor of the Prime Tower, ~120 m up with sweeping views over the city, Lake Zurich and the Alps. Open kitchen and an award-winning bar (Falstaff 'best bars in Switzerland 2026').

places.name: Frau Gerolds Garten
places.area: Zürich West (Geroldareal, Kreis 5, at the foot of Prime Tower)
places.near: Geroldstrasse 23, directly beside Zürich Hardbrücke station; tram 4 or 17 to Schiffbau, or a few minutes' walk from Hardbrücke. About 8-10 min from Zurich HB via S-Bahn to Hardbrücke.
places.order: Grilled dishes and bratwurst; seasonal salads and vegetables from the on-site garden; cheese fondue in the Winter Garten; changing summer menu.
places.notes: Food-focused urban garden that is family-friendly by day and more of a social/party spot at night; included as it is a real food/social space. Confirmed open (2026 reviews and published summer season). · v1 POI Finder
places.famousFor: An iconic industrial-chic urban garden built from shipping containers under the railway viaduct, with street art, planted beds and a lively all-ages atmosphere; grows its own herbs, vegetables and fruit used in the kitchen.
places.goodToKnow: Family- and group-friendly by day (open, casual, kids welcome); summer season runs roughly April 3 to September 26, 2026 (open daily, often until midnight), converting to a cosy Winter Garten with a fondue parlour off-season. It also has a bar, but it is a genuine food/social garden space suitable for families earlier in the day; expect a young, busy crowd and DJ/party vibe on summer evenings. Great for photos.

places.name: Coco Grill & Bar
places.near: Right at Paradeplatz - trams 6, 7, 8, 9, 11, 13 to Paradeplatz stop; about a 10-minute walk (or one tram stop) south from Zurich HB.
places.order: Charcoal-grilled Angus fillet, aged bone-in cote de boeuf, veal cutlets, rib-eye, or Tomahawk; from the sea: rock lobster, monkfish, European sea bass (loup de mer); market-fresh vegetables and sides. Pair with the wine list.
places.notes: Stylish, buzzy grill in a prime Paradeplatz location; consistently well reviewed and firmly open in 2026. · v1 POI Finder
places.famousFor: Instagrammable glam grill house on Paradeplatz with a leafy Mediterranean herb-garden courtyard tucked into Zurich's banking district; charcoal grill is the centerpiece and the room is a see-and-be-seen spot.
places.goodToKnow: Upper price segment (expect roughly CHF 150-200+ per person with wine). Book ahead, especially for a courtyard-garden table in warm months, which is the most romantic/photogenic seating. Smart-casual to elegant dress fits the crowd. Open kitchen and glowing grill make for great photos; evenings are lively.

places.name: Razzia
places.cuisine: Modern international with exotic/Asian accents; grill-focused
places.near: Seefeldstrasse in Seefeld - tram 2 or 4 to Feldeggstrasse/Höschgasse, or bus; roughly a 20-minute walk along the lake from Zurich HB, or a short tram ride.
places.order: Seasonal open-kitchen dishes such as the spring salad and the signature 'Symphonie' plate; grill specialties; and desserts from the acclaimed pastry team (Felicia Ludwig, Patissiere of the Year 2022).
places.notes: The room alone is worth the visit; food is good if not the main draw and prices are high. Confirmed operating in 2026. · v1 POI Finder
places.famousFor: A spectacular six-meter-high former silent-cinema auditorium (the old 'Kinematographen-Theater Seefeld') turned dramatic restaurant and bar - one of Zurich's most photographed dining rooms, with exotic jungle-print decor against historic architecture, a walk-in wine chamber (150+ wines) and a romantic rear courtyard garden.
places.goodToKnow: Restaurant hours Tue-Fri 11:45-14:30 & 18:00-23:00, Sat dinner only 18:00-23:00, closed Sun-Mon (bar Tue-Sat from 16:00). Reserve ahead and request the main hall for the wow-factor, or the courtyard garden in summer for romance. Pricey and the room is dim/dramatic - great for atmosphere photos; smart-casual dress.

places.name: Restaurant Belvoirpark
places.cuisine: Swiss tradition + cosmopolitan market cuisine (seasonal, local)
places.near: Tram 7 to Brunaustrasse, or about a 7-minute walk from Bahnhof Enge (S-Bahn); roughly 10-15 minutes by tram from Zurich HB.
places.order: Zurich classic Zürcher Kalbsgeschnetzeltes (sliced veal in cream sauce) with rösti; seasonal market menu built on local/seasonal ingredients; cheese fondue in winter; vegetarian/vegan on request.
places.notes: Beautiful historic-villa-and-park setting; reopened and operating in 2026 under new management. · v1 POI Finder
places.famousFor: Set in the neoclassical Villa Escher (1830, former home of Alfred Escher) within Belvoirpark, one of the oldest landscaped gardens in Zurich - an elegant, green, romantic setting reopened by Kramer Gastronomie after the previous restaurant closed at end of 2022.
places.goodToKnow: Open Wed-Sun ~11:00-23:00, closed Mon-Tue (confirm when booking). Reserve ahead; a terrace/park-view table is the romantic pick in good weather. Popular for weddings and celebrations, so weekends fill up. Smart-casual dress. Reservations: 044 576 40 40 / info@belvoirpark.ch. (Note: a separate, older Belvoirpark listing tied to the former hotel-school restaurant still appears online - this entry is the current Kramer-run restaurant.)

places.name: Parkhuus
places.cuisine: Modern European - Swiss-rooted with Mediterranean influences
places.near: Beethovenstrasse/Dreikönigstrasse near Bürkliplatz and the lake - trams 6, 7, 8, 9, 11, 13 to Paradeplatz or trams to Börsenstrasse/Bürkliplatz; about a 10-12 minute walk from Zurich HB.
places.order: Alp trout from San Bernardino served on Lake Zurich stones; buffalo mozzarella with melted tomatoes and house pesto; in-house-butchered air-dried meats; truffle gnocchi in season; and for two, the grilled Tomahawk or Chateaubriand. Available à la carte or as a tasting menu.
places.notes: Reliable, high-end hotel fine-dining; open and well rated through 2026 with events booked to end of 2026. · v1 POI Finder
places.famousFor: The signature restaurant of the 5-star Park Hyatt Zurich - a spacious, high-ceilinged room with an open kitchen and a striking glassed-in, multi-story Wine Library (3,000+ labels); refined, produce-driven cooking by chef Timotej Mužila.
places.goodToKnow: Book ahead (OpenTable or the hotel); the Wine Library is a stylish, intimate spot for a couple or special celebration. Fine-dining prices; smart/elegant dress advised. High Falstaff 2026 scores (45/50 food). A polished, quieter romantic choice versus the flashier grill rooms.

places.name: Alpenrose
places.near: Fabrikstrasse in Kreis 5 - short walk from Zurich-West; trams 4/13/17 toward Escher-Wyss/Quellenstrasse or a ~12-15 minute walk from Zurich HB across the tracks.
places.order: Rösli's veal meatloaf (Kalbshackbraten) with mushroom cream sauce and homemade spätzli; seasonal Swiss dishes and vegetarian options; watch for regional specials such as the June 2026 Tessiner Wochen (Ticino weeks) with Mediterranean summer plates.
places.notes: Confirmed currently open and operating in 2026 (Yelp updated June 2026; official site lists June 2026 Ticino-weeks event and current hours). Cozy/traditional, not a scenic or glamorous venue. · v1 POI Finder
places.famousFor: A charming, wood-panelled traditional Swiss restaurant celebrated for hearty, honest home cooking ('made with love') from regional Swiss produce; run since 2016 by the Stiftung Arbeitskette social foundation.
places.goodToKnow: Open Tue-Fri 11:30-14:00 & 17:30-23:00, Sat 17:30-23:00, Sun 17:30-22:00, closed Mon. Cozy and intimate rather than glamorous - a warm, characterful spot for a relaxed romantic dinner. Reserve ahead (044 431 11 66 / alpenrose@arbeitskette.ch), especially weekends. Casual dress is fine.

places.name: LILY'S ORIGINAL
places.near: Tram 8 to Bäckeranlage, or ~12-15 min walk from Zurich HB along Langstrasse; a few minutes' walk from Zurich Langstrasse rail station.
places.order: Thai and Indian curries, Far Eastern noodle soups, pad thai, dumplings, fresh salads and bao/spring rolls from the open wok; strong vegetarian and vegan choices.
places.notes: Confirmed open and well-reviewed; notably vegetarian- and family-friendly casual spot. · v1 POI Finder
places.famousFor: Hip, buzzy Langstrasse institution (since 1999) serving fresh wok cooking from Thailand, Korea, China, Japan, Vietnam and India at an open flame station; a Zurich casual-Asian classic and long-time nightlife-district favourite.
places.goodToKnow: Casual, no-frills, quick service — great for families and groups; lots of veggie/vegan options. Busy at lunch and on weekend evenings; walk-ins normal but expect a wait at peak. Open Mon-Sat into the late evening.

places.name: HITZBERGER HB Halle Löwenstrasse
places.near: Inside Zürich HB on level -2 (Halle Löwenstrasse, ShopVille) — 0 min from the main station; other branches at Sihlcity, Hardbrücke and Migros City.
places.order: Wraps, curries, fresh salads (green-bean and tabbouleh salads are popular), soups, sandwiches, and fresh-squeezed juices and smoothies.
places.notes: Confirmed currently operating in 2026 (Migros-owned; © 2026 on official site); healthy and vegetarian-friendly. Multiple central branches. · v1 POI Finder
places.famousFor: Health-focused fast food from natural, freshly prepared ingredients — a concept created by Michelin-decorated chef Eduard Hitzberger and now run by Migros Zurich; a convenient, better-for-you grab-and-go across several central Zurich spots.
places.goodToKnow: Fast, counter-service and casual — easy with kids and good for a healthy quick bite between trains. Plenty of vegetarian/lighter options. Busiest at weekday lunch; largely a take-away/quick-eat format rather than sit-down dining.

places.name: Outback Lodge, Zürich Stadelhofen
places.near: At Stadelhofen station (Stadelhofer Passage) — S-Bahn and trams 2/4/11/15 stop right there; ~8-10 min walk or one tram stop from Zurich HB, a short stroll from Lake Zurich.
places.order: Australian spare ribs (Sunday ribs deal with sweet-potato mash & fries), steaks and grills, chicken wings; a plant-based 'crocodile' steak and salads are also on the menu.
places.notes: Confirmed open in 2026 (official site lists Aug 2026 hours). Food-first steakhouse and casual, but only a mid-range 3.6/5 rating and family-suitable mainly at daytime/early evening due to the evening 18+ policy; limited vegetarian options. · v1 POI Finder
places.famousFor: Long-running (since 1997) Aussie-themed grill right at Stadelhofen station — spare ribs, steaks and chicken wings with a laid-back 'down under' atmosphere; also home to the hidden Sly Grog cocktail bar.
places.goodToKnow: Cashless (cards/Twint). Fine for families at lunch and early dinner, BUT admission is 18+ from 9:00 pm on Fri & Sat (bar-club vibe later) — go earlier if bringing children. Reservations advised for weekends and for the ribs deals. Vegetarian choice is limited.

places.name: The Restaurant
places.near: From Zürich HB take tram 3 to Römerhof (~5 min), then the Dolderbahn funicular up to Bergstation Dolder, steps from the hotel (funicular runs ~every 10 min until 23:30). ~20-25 min total; taxi ~15 min.
places.order: The multi-course evening 'The Restaurant' tasting menu (with a full vegetarian counterpart); a lighter amuse-bouche lunch menu Thu/Fri; the 5-seat Chef's Table inside the kitchen. Wine pairings from an 800+ label cellar.
places.notes: Zurich's top table; the city's benchmark 2-star. Confidently open in 2026. · v1 POI Finder
places.famousFor: Zurich's flagship gastronomic address; chef Heiko Nieder's precise, creative flavor-driven cooking (19 GaultMillau points) inside a landmark hilltop palace hotel with sweeping city and lake views.
places.goodToKnow: Book weeks ahead; smart/elegant dress expected. Evening service Wed-Sat from 19:00, lunch Thu-Fri 12:00-14:00. Special-occasion pricing. Great sunset/terrace photos before dinner. Not a young-kids venue.

places.name: Widder Restaurant
places.cuisine: Modern European / French haute with Asian accents
places.near: In the Old Town by Rennweg, ~8-10 min walk from Zürich HB; tram 6/7/11/13 to Rennweg stop is a 2-min walk. Near Bahnhofstrasse.
places.order: The 4- to 6-course set menu or its vegetarian version; signatures like langoustine with tom yam/peanut/kaffir lime, Balfegó tuna tartare, and the pulled-goulash bao amuse. À la carte chef's recommendations also available.
places.notes: The real fine-dining room at Widder Hotel (distinct from the casual Boucherie AuGust). Firmly open in 2026 with 2 stars. · v1 POI Finder
places.famousFor: Chef Stefan Heilemann (who brought his two stars over from the former Ecco Zürich) cooking refined, acidity-driven French-based cuisine with a smart Asian twist, set across medieval houses of the luxury Widder Hotel.
places.goodToKnow: Reserve well ahead; smart/elegant dress. Dinner-focused, closed early week. City's deepest wine program. Central location makes it easy pre/post shopping. Adults-oriented fine dining.

places.name: IGNIV Zürich by Andreas Caminada
places.area: Old Town / Niederdorf (Marktgasse, right bank of the Limmat)
places.near: In Niederdorf on Marktgasse; tram 4 or 15 to Rathaus, then ~1-2 min walk up Marktgasse. ~10-12 min walk from Zürich HB across the river.
places.order: The sharing set menu (with vegetarian option), supplemented à la carte; save room for the signature IGNIV 'Candy Store' dessert finale.
places.notes: Distinctive shared-plates format at 2-star level; confirmed open in 2026. · v1 POI Finder
places.famousFor: Andreas Caminada's acclaimed 'fine dining sharing' concept — dishes designed to be shared around the table — executed by head chef Daniel Zeindlhofer inside the boutique Marktgasse Hotel. 2 stars since 2022.
places.goodToKnow: Book several weeks ahead (Tock). Closed some weeks in spring/summer (approx. 20 Apr-3 May and 20 Jul-9 Aug 2026). Lively, convivial atmosphere; good for couples and groups who like to share. Smart-casual.

places.name: Baur au Lac
places.area: City centre / near Paradeplatz (Talstrasse, by the hotel's private park)
places.near: City centre near the lake and Paradeplatz; ~10 min walk from Zürich HB down Bahnhofstrasse, or tram 2/6/7/8/9/11/13 to Paradeplatz then ~4 min walk.
places.order: The seasonal tasting menu or à la carte; classically refined French dishes. À la carte/menus roughly CHF 160-280 pp.
places.notes: Long-standing luxury-hotel fine dining; current kitchen continues the two-star tradition. Open in 2026. · v1 POI Finder
places.famousFor: The elegant gourmet restaurant of the storied Baur au Lac hotel — a glass pavilion with Lalique chandeliers overlooking the private garden — serving light, precise contemporary French cuisine.
places.goodToKnow: Reserve ahead; jacket/smart dress fitting a grand hotel. Beautiful garden/glass-dome setting for photos. Polished, formal service; adults-oriented.

places.name: EquiTable AG
places.near: In Kreis 4 near Stauffacher; tram 2/3/8/9/14 to Stauffacher, then a short walk. ~10 min tram from Zürich HB.
places.order: The seasonal multi-course menu built around ethically sourced and vegetable-led ingredients; ask about the sustainability story behind each course.
places.notes: Zurich's standout 'green'/sustainable one-star. Confirmed open in 2026. · v1 POI Finder
places.famousFor: A pioneering sustainability-focused fine-dining corner restaurant — Fairtrade, organic and locally/ethically sourced produce — where chef Julian Marti bridges classic fine dining and vegetable-forward cooking.
places.goodToKnow: Small room, reserve ahead. Dinner Tue-Sat from 18:30, closed Sun/Mon. Smart-casual; relaxed but serious kitchen. Strong choice for vegetable-forward and ethically minded diners.

places.name: KLE
places.near: In Wiedikon (Kreis 3) on Zweierstrasse; tram 9/14 or bus to Bezirksgebäude/Kalkbreite area, short walk. ~10-12 min from Zürich HB.
places.order: The evening surprise tasting menu (choose 4-6 courses), entirely vegan; thoughtful non-alcoholic and natural-wine pairings emphasizing regionality.
places.notes: Switzerland's benchmark vegan star; chef is Zineb Hattab (some blogs misname the chef). Open in 2026. · v1 POI Finder
places.famousFor: Chef Zineb 'Zizi' Hattab's fully vegan fine-dining restaurant — the first vegan kitchen in Switzerland to hold a Michelin (red) star plus the Green star — with creative Moroccan/Mexican-inflected plant cooking.
places.goodToKnow: Small, popular — book ahead. Surprise menu format (note allergies when booking). Relaxed, cozy vibe; excellent for vegans/vegetarians and the curious. Smart-casual.

places.name: Rico's così!
places.area: Küsnacht (Lake Zürich shore, ~8 km SE of central Zürich — outside the city proper)
places.near: In Küsnacht ZH on Seestrasse (lakeside), NOT in Zurich city. From Zürich HB take the S6/S16 S-Bahn to Küsnacht (~12 min) then a short walk/taxi, or ~15 min drive along the lake.
places.order: The 3- to 8-course set menu; classic luxury ingredients with Mediterranean/Ticinese character. Lunch offered Wed-Fri.
places.notes: Included as a top nearby 2-star; located in Küsnacht, not Zurich proper (as requested, flagged). · v1 POI Finder
places.famousFor: Rico Zandonella's long-celebrated lakeside gourmet restaurant (the former 'Kunststuben') — classic, richly flavored Mediterranean-leaning cooking in a characterful villa by Lake Zürich.
places.goodToKnow: Reserve ahead; smart/elegant dress. Closed Mon-Tue. Note it is in Küsnacht, a lakeside municipality just outside Zurich (worth the short trip). Lovely lake setting; adults-oriented.

places.name: Boucherie AuGust
places.near: On Rennweg in the Old Town; ~8-10 min walk from Zürich HB, or tram 6/7/11/13 to Rennweg (2-min walk).
places.order: Meatloaf, house pâtés and terrines, tartare, sausages; adventurous cuts like tripe, boiled-beef salad and pork belly.
places.notes: Listed by MICHELIN; strong high-end casual option (not starred). Open in 2026. · v1 POI Finder
places.famousFor: The Widder Hotel's chic butcher-style restaurant (designed by Tilla Theus) reviving hearty regional Swiss meat classics and forgotten cuts — a more accessible, atmospheric counterpart to the two-star Widder Restaurant.
places.goodToKnow: Open daily ~11:30-23:00; reservations recommended, especially the terrace on Rennweg in summer. Smart-casual; livelier and more relaxed than Widder Restaurant. Good for meat lovers and a more casual upscale meal.

places.name: Park Hyatt Zurich
places.area: Enge / City centre (Beethovenstrasse, near the lake and Bahnhofstrasse's south end)
places.near: City centre near Talstrasse/Enge; ~10-12 min walk from Zürich HB, or tram 2/9 to Stockerstrasse, short walk. Near Paradeplatz.
places.order: Seasonal Swiss-sourced dishes from the wood oven; the à la carte and seasonal menus. Ask the sommelier to show the glass wine tower.
places.notes: Reliable upscale contemporary dining in the centre; open in 2026 (not currently starred). · v1 POI Finder
places.famousFor: The Park Hyatt's airy, design-forward restaurant built around a central wood-burning oven and a glass-walled two-story wine vault; chef Timotej Mužila cooks produce-driven Swiss cuisine.
places.goodToKnow: Reservations recommended. Lunch Tue-Fri 12:00-14:00, dinner Tue-Sat from 18:00. Smart-casual; polished but relaxed hotel setting that is more family/business-friendly than the tasting-menu temples. Striking wine-vault photos.

places.name: The Counter
places.near: Directly opposite Zürich HB main station; any tram to Bahnhofplatz/HB
places.order: The surprise tasting menu (state no-pork/no-alcohol at booking; signature is steamed turbot with radish and saffron-ponzu); alcohol-free pairing available
places.notes: Michelin Guide Switzerland 2026 listing (2 stars), guide.michelin.com
places.famousFor: Two Michelin stars (2026 guide); chef Mitja Birlo moved from 2-star 7132 Silver in Vals; you sit at the counter of an open kitchen and watch a surprise tasting menu built course by course
places.goodToKnow: Dietary: fish-forward menu, kitchen adapts for no-pork/no-alcohol if told in advance; counter format = best for the parents + older teens (not a 4-year-old table). Wed-Fri dinner only, Sat lunch + dinner, CLOSED Sun-Tue. $$$$ (CHF 300+ pp). Book weeks ahead.

places.name: Neue Taverne
places.near: 5-min walk from Bahnhofstrasse/Rennweg; tram 6/7/11/13 to Rennweg
places.order: Aubergine with miso, wasabi-sesame and cashew; buckwheat dumplings with truffle and cheese; evening 'Tavolata' surprise menu; alcohol-free kombucha pairings
places.notes: Michelin Guide Switzerland 2026 (1 star), guide.michelin.com
places.famousFor: One Michelin star for an all-vegetable kitchen; modern gastropub feel, dishes to share; summer tables on the little square outside
places.goodToKnow: Dietary: 100% vegetarian (some vegan) so everything is orderable. Good-value 2-course business lunch Mon-Fri. Open Mon-Sat lunch + dinner, CLOSED Sunday. $$$. Book ahead for dinner.

places.name: Eden Kitchen & Bar
places.area: Seefeld / Utoquai lakefront (La Réserve Eden au Lac)
places.near: Tram 2/4 to Kreuzstrasse or 10-min lakeside walk from Bellevue along Utoquai
places.order: House-made ravioli; paccheri with Breton lobster; Zürcher Geschnetzeltes (veal); grilled fish of the day; kids can have the cheeseburger (beef) or plain pasta
places.notes: Michelin Guide 2026 (1 star) + lareserve-zurich.com hours
places.famousFor: One Michelin star + 17 GaultMillau points in a relaxed hotel brasserie with a green-tiled open kitchen and big windows onto Lake Zürich; ~20 à-la-carte dishes so families can each pick
places.goodToKnow: Dietary: à la carte with plenty of fish/pasta/veal; ask for pork-free. Open DAILY incl. Sunday (Lazy Sunday brunch 12-15, Sunday Roast 15-21). $$$$ but no tasting-menu obligation. Book via SevenRooms.

places.name: La Rôtisserie (Hotel Storchen)
places.area: Old Town / Weinplatz on the Limmat
places.cuisine: Modern international take on classic cuisine
places.near: Tram 4/15 to Rathaus, then cross Rathausbrücke; or walk from Paradeplatz (5 min)
places.order: Seasonal fish and veal classics from the à la carte; the Sunday brunch; Chef's Table in the kitchen for a special night
places.notes: Michelin Guide Switzerland 2026 (1 star) + storchen.ch
places.famousFor: One Michelin star on the first floor of the 14th-century Storchen hotel; high arched windows and a terrace right over the Limmat facing the Grossmünster; Sunday brunch
places.goodToKnow: Dietary: classic à la carte, fish and veal always present; tell them no-pork. Sunday brunch served (rare for a starred room). $$$$. Smart-casual; book, riverside terrace tables go first.

places.name: ORSINI (Mandarin Oriental Savoy)
places.cuisine: Contemporary Italian (chef Dario Moresco, patron Antonio Guida of 2-star Seta Milan)
places.near: Steps from Paradeplatz tram hub (2/8/9/11/13); entrance on Waaggasse
places.order: Seasonal tasting menu or the chef's 'signature classics' menu; business lunch Tue-Fri is the affordable way in; fish-led courses easy to arrange
places.notes: Michelin Guide Switzerland 2026 (1 star), guide.michelin.com
places.famousFor: One Michelin star inside the reborn 1838 Savoy on Paradeplatz; gossamer nettle tagliolini with oysters and sea-fennel pesto; celebrated cheese trolley; rooftop aperitif terrace
places.goodToKnow: Dietary: Italian fine dining, pork-free adaptation on request. Tue-Fri lunch 12-13:30 + dinner 18:30-20:30 (last seating), Sat dinner only, CLOSED Sun-Mon. $$$$. Best for parents + teens; book well ahead. · Location needs verification

places.name: Wirtschaft im FRANZ
places.near: Tram 2/3 to Zwinglihaus or bus 32 to Bremgartnerstrasse; 10 min from HB
places.order: 4- to 6-course seasonal tasting menu (vegetarian version available); staff explain every ingredient's origin
places.notes: Michelin Guide Switzerland 2026 (1 star), guide.michelin.com
places.famousFor: One Michelin star hidden in a culture-and-food courtyard in Wiedikon; open kitchen, relaxed bistro room, charming courtyard terrace; the neighbourhood's best-kept secret
places.goodToKnow: Dietary: vegetable-led, vegetarian menu on offer, so no-pork is trivial. Tue-Sat dinner only 18:00-23:30, CLOSED Sun-Mon. $$$. Small room, book ahead.

places.name: Shin (Sushi Shin)
places.near: Side street off Münsterhof, 3-min walk from Paradeplatz
places.order: The omakase (about CHF 350 pp evenings); weekday lunch sittings are the gentler entry point
places.notes: Michelin Guide Switzerland 2026 (1 star) + cremeguides.com
places.famousFor: Zürich's Michelin-starred sushi counter: just 8 seats, chef decides the evening's menu from the day's wild-caught fish; as close to Tokyo as Switzerland gets
places.goodToKnow: Dietary: all fish/seafood, naturally pork-free. Only 8 counter seats = parents-only or with the eldest; not for small kids. Lunch Tue-Fri, dinner Mon-Sat, CLOSED Sunday. $$$$. Book far ahead.

places.name: Wöschi
places.cuisine: Modern regional tasting menu (chef David Klocksin)
places.near: Bus 161/165 or tram 7 to Wollishofen then short walk; 15 min from Bürkliplatz
places.order: The regional tasting menu (vegetarian version available); alcohol-free pairing on offer
places.notes: Michelin Guide Switzerland 2026 (1 star), guide.michelin.com
places.famousFor: One Michelin star in a former laundry-house right on Wollishofen harbour with a terrace on the water; vegetables and fermentation lead, premium fish and meat follow
places.goodToKnow: Dietary: tasting-menu only, tell them no-pork when booking. Tue-Sat dinner from 18:30, CLOSED Sunday. $$$$. Terrace on the lake in mild October evenings; book ahead.

places.name: Rigiblick Züriberg Beiz
places.area: Zürichberg / Oberstrass (top of the Rigiblick funicular)
places.near: Tram 9/10 to Seilbahn Rigiblick, then the Rigiblick funicular to the top station
places.order: Seasonal lake fish, veal and vegetable plates from the daily-changing regional menu; Sunday lunch here is a local ritual
places.notes: Michelin Guide 2026 (Bib Gourmand), guide.michelin.com
places.famousFor: Michelin Bib Gourmand hillside 'Beiz' above the city with a leafy terrace and the best free view over Zürich and the lake; reached by its own little funicular, which kids love
places.goodToKnow: Dietary: Swiss farm cooking, fish and veal on the menu, pork dishes clearly labelled. Wed-Sat 11:30-24:00, SUNDAY OPEN 11:30-23:00, closed Mon-Tue. $$ (Bib = value). Book for the terrace. (Same building also has 'Rigiblick Comfort Fine Dining' upstairs.)

places.name: Gül
places.cuisine: Modern Turkish, wood-fire and grill (Elif Oskan)
places.near: Tram 8 or bus 32 to Helvetiaplatz, 3-min walk
places.order: Mini lahmacun, manti, wood-fired flatbreads, grilled lamb and fish platters to share; Turkish breakfast at weekend brunch
places.notes: Michelin Guide 2026 (Bib Gourmand), guide.michelin.com
places.famousFor: Michelin Bib Gourmand and Zürich's cult Turkish table: chef Elif Oskan's open kitchen, wood-fired oven, sharing platters, and a lively courtyard atmosphere
places.goodToKnow: Dietary: Turkish menu is naturally pork-free (lamb, beef, chicken, fish, lots of veg); alcohol served. Mon-Fri dinner only, Sat brunch + dinner, SUNDAY OPEN 11-15 and 18-22. $$. Book, it fills nightly.

places.name: Gaijin Izakaya
places.cuisine: Creative Japanese izakaya / Asian soul food (chef Daniel Shu)
places.near: Tram 2/3/8/9/14 to Stauffacher, 1-min walk
places.order: Omakase small-plate sequence or à la carte: fish crudo, tempura, chicken karaage, rice bowls; ask for pork-free ramen/dumplings
places.notes: Michelin Guide 2026 (Bib Gourmand), guide.michelin.com
places.famousFor: Michelin Bib Gourmand izakaya by a Chicago/New York-trained chef; relaxed music-driven room, omakase or à la carte small plates
places.goodToKnow: Dietary: Japanese menu uses pork in some buns/ramen, but many fish/chicken/veg plates; say no-pork. Lunch Mon-Fri (limited), dinner DAILY incl. Sunday 18-24. $$. Reserve directly by phone.

places.name: Bauernschänke
places.near: Tram 4/15 to Rathaus, 3-min walk up into the Niederdorf
places.order: Beef tartare, scallops, seasonal fish and vegetable plates to share; the Tavolata for the table
places.notes: Michelin Guide 2026 (Bib Gourmand), guide.michelin.com
places.famousFor: Michelin Bib Gourmand in a cosy historic dining room in a narrow Old-Town lane; hand-cut beef tartare with brioche, seared scallops, 3-5 course 'Tavolata' surprise menu
places.goodToKnow: Dietary: French sharing menu, pork appears in some plates; tell them at booking. Lunch Tue-Sat, dinner Mon-Sat, CLOSED Sunday. $$-$$$. Small room, book.

places.name: Josef
places.cuisine: Contemporary European small plates, Mediterranean accents
places.near: Tram 4/13/17 to Quellenstrasse or 8-min walk from Hardbrücke station
places.order: Charcoal-grilled guinea fowl with courgette-flower tempura; seasonal fish and vegetable plates; 5-course set menu in omnivore or vegetarian version
places.notes: Michelin Guide 2026 (Bib Gourmand), guide.michelin.com
places.famousFor: Michelin Bib Gourmand and a Kreis 5 institution: trendy urban room, starter-sized plates (order ~4 pp), charcoal grill, lively bar crowd
places.goodToKnow: Dietary: plates change daily; pork-free choices always available, ask. Dinner only Tue-Sat from 17:00, CLOSED Sun-Mon. $$. Late, buzzy, better for parents + teens.

places.name: La Bottega di Mario
places.near: 3-min walk from Bahnhofstrasse/Sihlporte; tram 2/9 to Sihlstrasse
places.order: Fresh pasta, risotto, grilled fish and veal from the daily board; note the salumeria is pork-heavy, so skip the cold cuts
places.notes: Michelin Guide 2026 (Bib Gourmand), guide.michelin.com
places.famousFor: Michelin Bib Gourmand in a 1913 building: lively ristorante with a deli counter, Ticino-influenced cooking, house Merlot poured from a six-litre bottle
places.goodToKnow: Dietary: pasta/fish/veal fine, avoid the salumi platters. Tue-Fri lunch + dinner, Sat 11:30-24:00, CLOSED Sun-Mon. $$. Family-friendly noise level; book.

places.name: Didi's Frieden
places.near: Tram 7/11/14 to Stampfenbachplatz or 8-min walk from HB via Central
places.order: Appenzell lamb, lake fish, veal patties with thyme jus; lunch daily specials; 3-5 course evening set menu
places.notes: Michelin Guide 2026 (Bib Gourmand) + Yelp/Corner hours
places.famousFor: Michelin Bib Gourmand for honest Swiss craftsmanship cooking under wine-glass chandeliers; Appenzell mountain lamb, meat patties with chanterelles and Ribel polenta; summer terrace
places.goodToKnow: Dietary: Swiss menu with lamb/veal/fish; pork dishes labelled, ask. Mon-Fri lunch 11:30-14:30 + dinner from 17:00, Sat dinner only, CLOSED Sunday. $$-$$$. Book for dinner.

places.name: Barranco
places.near: Tram 2/3 to Lochergut or bus 32; 10 min from Stauffacher
places.order: Ceviches, tiraditos, grilled fish, vegetable plates, sweet-potato sides; mocktails and pisco-free options for the kids
places.notes: Michelin Guide 2026 (Bib Gourmand), guide.michelin.com
places.famousFor: Michelin Bib Gourmand neighbourhood spot inspired by Lima's Barranco district: Peruvian murals, sheltered terrace, punchy ceviches and spice-driven plates to share
places.goodToKnow: Dietary: fish/chicken/beef-led, pork rare; say no-pork. Dinner only Tue-Sun 18-24, CLOSED Monday; SUNDAY OPEN. $$. Reserve by phone/website.

places.name: Fischer's Fritz
places.area: Wollishofen / Lake Zürich shore (Seestrasse, by the city campsite)
places.near: Bus 161/165 from Bürkliplatz to Stadtgrenze/Camping; or the summer water taxi; 15 min by car from centre
places.order: Fischchnusperli (crispy fried lake fish) with fries; trout bleu from Lake Zürich; crispy chicken in a basket with house sauce; brunch
places.notes: zuerich.com + fischers-fritz.ch
places.famousFor: Zürich's beloved lakeside fish 'Beiz' with a huge terrace right on the water and the Alps opposite; fish from its own house fisherman Adrian Gerny; reachable by water taxi
places.goodToKnow: Dietary: fish and chicken are the point, easy no-pork. Open DAILY 11:30-24:00 incl. Sunday (check winter hours by phone in late October). $$-$$$. Very family-friendly (campsite, lawn, boats); book the terrace.

places.name: Restaurant Seerose
places.near: Bus 161/165 to Seerose or tram 7 to Post Wollishofen + 8-min walk; boat/taxi-boat in season
places.order: Swiss trout fillet with champagne sauce; grilled sole; stone-pine ravioli; beef tournedos; weekend breakfast on the water
places.notes: seerose.dinning.ch + timeout.com
places.famousFor: Yacht-deck-style lakeside restaurant with its own harbour and moorings, 250-seat wooden terrace with white lounge furniture, views of the Alps and city skyline; new rooftop dining space
places.goodToKnow: Dietary: fish-strong menu, pork-free mains easy. Open DAILY 10:00-24:00 incl. Sunday (weekend breakfast 10-12). $$$ (lunch mains CHF 25-32). Book the terrace; all-day 'afternoon menu' handy with kids.

places.name: Sternen Grill
places.near: Right at Bellevue tram hub (2/4/5/8/9/11/15), by the Opera
places.order: St. Galler Kalbsbratwurst (VEAL sausage) with Bürli and mustard; Cervelat and Schüblig are pork, so skip; upstairs restaurant does rösti and Geschnetzeltes
places.notes: sternengrill.ch + zuerich.com
places.famousFor: The most famous sausage stand in Switzerland, on Bellevue since 1962: St. Galler Bratwurst with the 'devilishly' hot Sternen mustard and a crispy Gold-Bürli; sit-down restaurant upstairs
places.goodToKnow: Dietary: order ONLY the St. Galler veal bratwurst (other sausages contain pork; grill shares surfaces). Take-away DAILY 10:30-23:45, Restaurant OBEN daily 11:30-22:00; SUNDAY OPEN. $. No reservations; quick fun stop.

places.name: Rosaly's Restaurant & Bar
places.near: 2-min walk from Bellevue (tram hub), behind the Opera
places.order: Zürcher Geschnetzeltes (veal) with rösti; Chässpätzli; St. Galler veal bratwurst with rösti; seasonal fish; Rösti for the kids
places.notes: rosalys.ch + GaultMillau + cremeguides
places.famousFor: 'Like at mom's, but without mom': Zürich's trendiest home-cooking address, celebrated for its Zürcher Geschnetzeltes with rösti, Chässpätzli and Ghackets mit Hörnli, run by the Sternen Grill family
places.goodToKnow: Dietary: veal/beef/fish/cheese dishes make no-pork easy; Ghackets mit Hörnli may be mixed mince, ask. Open daily; SUNDAY 17:00-24:00 dinner only. $$-$$$. Book, small and always full.

places.name: Haus zum Rüden
places.near: Tram 4/15 to Helmhaus, right at Münsterbrücke
places.order: Zürcher Geschnetzeltes with rösti; lake fish and duck; the better-value lunch menu; bar terrace for lighter plates
places.notes: Michelin Guide 2026 (selected) + zuerich.com
places.famousFor: 1348 guild house whose Gothic Room has an 11-metre-wide wooden barrel-vaulted ceiling; the grandest historic dining room in Zürich, with a modern bar-terrace over the Limmat
places.goodToKnow: Dietary: classic menu with veal/fish/duck; specify no-pork. Tue-Sat 11:00-23:00, CLOSED Sun-Mon. $$-$$$ (lunch cheaper). Impressive room for a family dinner; book the Gothic Room.

places.name: Restaurant Kindli
places.near: Tram 6/7/11/13 to Rennweg, 2-min walk uphill towards Lindenhof
places.order: Sea bass with lemon and caper butter; Zürcher Kalbsgeschnetzeltes; seasonal classics; set menus for 6+
places.notes: Michelin Guide 2026 (selected) + kindli.ch
places.famousFor: Hospitality on this spot since 1474: wood-panelled, candle-lit Old-Town rooms in a boutique hotel; sea bass with lemon-caper butter and a much-praised Zürcher Geschnetzeltes
places.goodToKnow: Dietary: classic à la carte, fish and veal prominent; pork-free on request. Lunch 11:30-14:30 + dinner 18:00-23:30, CLOSED Sundays and holidays. $$$. Always booked out, reserve.

places.name: Bimi Japan Restaurant
places.cuisine: Japanese, classic + modern (chef Yutaka Ishizuka, 15 GaultMillau)
places.near: Tram 2/4 to Opernhaus, 3-min walk
places.order: Lunch 'Special Bento' with miso soup and generous sashimi; chirashi bowl; nigiri and sashimi omakase; grilled fish
places.notes: newlyswissed.com + newinzurich.com + GaultMillau
places.famousFor: Widely called the best sushi in Zürich, as close to Japan as you get in Switzerland; purist room, seasonal menus, big sake list; open since 2004
places.goodToKnow: Dietary: sushi/fish-led, naturally pork-free (ask on ramen/gyoza). Mon dinner only, Tue-Fri lunch 11:30-14:30 + dinner 18-23, Sat dinner, CLOSED Sunday. $$$. Book.

places.name: Sala of Tokyo
places.near: 3-min walk from Zürich HB / Bahnhofstrasse
places.order: The up-to-9-course omakase (CHF 140); miso-gratinated cod; tempura; sushi platters for the table; Kobe wagyu (CHF 180)
places.notes: Michelin Guide 2026 (selected) + zuerich.com
places.famousFor: Switzerland's first Japanese restaurant (1981) and still a gastronomic institution: first-class sushi, tempura, grilled crustaceans, Nobu-style miso black cod, Kobe wagyu
places.goodToKnow: Dietary: fish/beef/tempura menu, pork-free easy. Tue-Fri lunch 11:30-14:00 + dinner, Sat dinner, CLOSED Sun-Mon. $$$$. Classy room that still welcomes families at lunch; book.

places.name: KHOURIS
places.near: Tram 2/4 to Feldeggstrasse, 1-min walk
places.order: Charcoal-grilled chicken from the outdoor grill; shawarma; mezze platters to share (hummus, mutabbal, fattoush); vegetarian plates treated as mains
places.notes: newinzurich.com + zueriplausch.ch + amoiel.ch
places.famousFor: 2026's big Middle-Eastern opening (13 March 2026): the Khouris family (Palestine Grill, Samigo) went from pop-up to a permanent Seefeld home; oriental rugs, warm colours, Mama Khouris hosting; food 'that tastes like home'
places.goodToKnow: Dietary: Levantine kitchen, no pork on the menu (confirm halal sourcing directly). Open DAILY: Mon-Thu 11-23, Fri-Sat 11-23:30, SUNDAY 10-23. $$. Great family sharing table; book weekends.

places.name: SimSim City
places.near: Tram 7/15 to Schaffhauserplatz, 3-min walk; 10 min from HB
places.order: Mixed mezze (hummus, moutabal, kibbeh, fattoush), chicken shish taouk, mixed grill, lamb dishes; SimSim platters to share
places.notes: Tripadvisor Middle Eastern ranking + sim-sim.ch + myswitzerland.com
places.famousFor: Repeatedly voted the best Lebanese/Arabic restaurant in Zürich by diners for fresh mezze, warm hospitality of 'Chef Mo' and vegan/vegetarian/gluten-free breadth
places.goodToKnow: Dietary: Lebanese, pork-free menu with many vegan options (ask about halal). Mon-Sat 11:30-14:00 + 17:30-22:00, CLOSED Sunday. $$. Relaxed, family-friendly; sister branch in Oerlikon.

places.name: Tamarind Hill Indian Restaurant
places.near: S-Bahn/tram 10/14 to Oerlikon or Sternen Oerlikon, 5-min walk; 15 min from HB
places.order: Butter chicken; Rogan Josh (lamb); dal makhani; paneer dishes; tandoori breads; fish curry
places.notes: Tripadvisor Indian ranking + tamarindhill.ch
places.famousFor: One of Zürich's oldest and most consistently praised Indian kitchens ('possibly the best Indian restaurant in Europe' per reviewers); deep, balanced spicing
places.goodToKnow: Dietary: Indian menu naturally pork-free, lamb/chicken/veg/fish (ask about halal). Tue-Fri lunch 11-14 + dinner 17-22, Sat-Sun dinner 17-22, CLOSED Monday; SUNDAY OPEN (dinner). $$. Book for dinner.

places.name: Marküs
places.area: Old Town / Lindenhof (Glockengasse, former Kaiser's Reblaube)
places.cuisine: Creative Swiss with Japanese/Spanish influences (Markus Stöckle)
places.near: 5-min walk from Bahnhofstrasse/Rennweg; tram to Rennweg
places.order: The 12-course menu (meat or vegetarian, CHF 266): Lake Zürich felchen with fermented bean paste, quail consommé, reinvented Älpler Makkaronen; lunch classics like Kässpätzle planned later
places.notes: tsri.ch + GaultMillau + Falstaff Sept-2026 opening coverage
places.famousFor: THE Zürich opening of autumn 2026 (8 Sept 2026): ex-Rosi chef Markus Stöckle (Fat Duck alumnus) with partner Elif Oskan (Gül) in a 1260 house where Goethe once dined; 12-course tasting menus
places.goodToKnow: Dietary: tasting menu only, vegetarian version available, flag no-pork at booking. Dinner only for now (lunch to follow); confirm days on site. $$$$. Parents + eldest only; brand-new so book via SevenRooms early.

places.name: Villa Florhof - Bar & Brasserie (Lalique)
places.near: Tram 3/5/8/9 to Kunsthaus, 2-min walk; 8 min from Bellevue
places.order: Seasonal brasserie plates, fish and vegetable dishes from the garden terrace menu; afternoon tea/dessert stop after the Kunsthaus
places.notes: press.lalique.com + zuerich.com new-openings
places.famousFor: Lalique's first Zürich boutique hotel, opened 1 Aug 2026 in a 15th-century silk-merchant villa; garden-terrace brasserie now, with a first-floor Signature Restaurant due autumn 2026
places.goodToKnow: Dietary: à la carte brasserie, pork-free on request. Bar & Brasserie open DAILY 12:00-24:00 incl. Sunday. $$$-$$$$. Quiet garden = good with small kids at lunch; Signature Restaurant may be open by October, check.

places.name: DA NOI (ex da Pone)
places.near: Tram 4/13/17 or bus 46 to Wipkingerplatz; 10 min from HB
places.order: Margherita; Marinara; Bufalina; pizzas with vegetables, tuna or salmon; ask for prosciutto-free versions (crudo/salame are pork)
places.notes: 50 Top Pizza 2026 via danoi.ch + dishrank.ch + Falstaff
places.famousFor: Top Pizzeria in Switzerland 2026 and no. 26 in '50 Top Pizza Europe' 2026; 500°C oven, San Marzano tomatoes, fluffy digestible crust; terrace right on the Limmat
places.goodToKnow: Dietary: many pizzas carry pork cured meats, order veg/fish/bufala ones. Mon-Fri 11:30-14 + 18-23:30, Sat-SUNDAY 11:30-23:30 non-stop. $$. Families welcome; book for the river terrace.

places.name: Da Raffaele - Pizza & Panuozzi
places.near: In the Niederdorf pedestrian lane, 5 min from Central/HB
places.order: Margherita or Diavola-free choices like Ortolana (veg), Tonno, Bufala; panuozzo with grilled veg or chicken; tiramisu
places.notes: dishrank.ch + zuri.net + daraffaele.ch
places.famousFor: Small Niederdorf pizzeria that locals rank among Zürich's best: proper Neapolitan dough, fresh Italian toppings, panuozzo sandwiches, homemade desserts, open all day
places.goodToKnow: Dietary: skip salame/prosciutto pizzas, plenty of veg/cheese/fish ones. Open DAILY 11:00-21:45 incl. Sunday. $ (pizza ~CHF 18-24). Casual, quick, kid-proof; no need to book.

places.name: Pretty Patty - Smash Burger
places.near: 3-min walk from Zürich HB or Löwenplatz tram stop
places.order: Classic or Fancy smash (Swiss beef, cheddar, secret sauce); Oklahoma; Veggie for the vegetarians; fries and shakes; AVOID the Jalapeño (bacon jam)
places.notes: Falstaff streetfood + prettypatty.ch + newinzurich.com
places.famousFor: The 2025-26 smash-burger craze address near Bahnhofstrasse (sister to Geneva's original), Falstaff-listed; 'Oklahoma' onion-smashed patties, three sizes
places.goodToKnow: Dietary: all-beef patties; only the Jalapeño burger has bacon. Open DAILY 11:00-22:00 incl. Sunday. $ (CHF 10-22 per burger). No reservations, counter service, teens' favourite.

places.name: Restaurant Viadukt (Im Viadukt)
places.area: Zürich West / Kreis 5 (railway arches 8-9, Im Viadukt)
places.near: Tram 4/13/17 to Dammweg or 5-min walk from Hardbrücke station
places.order: Daily lunch menus (always a veg and a fish/meat option); evening seasonal plates; weekend breakfast; then browse the Markthalle stalls next door
places.notes: restaurant-viadukt.ch + theculturetrip Kreis 5 guide
places.famousFor: Built into two stone arches of the 1894 railway viaduct next to the Markthalle: curved vaults, industrial views, four lunch menus daily and a creative à la carte at night; doubles as concert venue Bogen F
places.goodToKnow: Dietary: mixed menu, veg/fish options every day; ask about pork. Open DAILY: Mon-Fri 8-24, Sat 9-24, SUNDAY 10-24. $$. Social-enterprise run, relaxed for kids; book weekend dinners.

places.name: La Muña Rooftop
places.area: Seefeld / Utoquai lakefront (6th floor, La Réserve Eden au Lac)
places.near: Tram 2/4 to Kreuzstrasse or 10-min lakeside walk from Bellevue
places.order: Classic and spicy ceviches; sashimi with ponzu; beef teriyaki with truffle sauce; grilled fish; 'Dulzor' dessert menu
places.notes: lareserve-zurich.com + Michelin Guide 2026 (selected) + cremeguides
places.famousFor: Philippe Starck-designed rooftop with 360° views of the Old Town, lake and Alps, reached by a glass lift; ceviches, tiraditos and sashimi built for sharing; two terraces
places.goodToKnow: Dietary: fish/beef/chicken-led, essentially pork-free. Open DAILY incl. Sunday: lunch 12-14, dinner 18-20:30 and 21-23:30 sittings. $$$$. Book via SevenRooms; the sunset sitting is the one to get.

places.name: Soï 28 by Stefan Heilemann
places.cuisine: Asian street & soul food by a 2-star chef
places.near: Tram 6/7/11/13 to Rennweg, 1-min walk
places.order: Homemade gyoza (ask filling), Thai beef salad, duck Massaman bao, Widder ramen (request pork-free broth), modern Tom Yum, sticky-rice-with-mango dessert; lunch Bento
places.notes: widderhotel.com + Michelin Guide 2026 (selected)
places.famousFor: The casual little sister of the 2-star Widder Restaurant: 20 seats, open kitchen, Bangkok-side-street inspiration (Soï = alley, 28 = the historic house number), Michelin-selected
places.goodToKnow: Dietary: pork-belly bun and some broths contain pork; several beef/duck/veg/seafood plates, ask. Mon/Thu/Fri 12-14 + 18-22, Sat 12-16 + 18-22, SUNDAY 18-22 (closed Tue-Wed per hotel site; verify). $$. Tiny, book online. · Location needs verification

places.name: Café Elena
places.order: Turkish breakfast; pancakes; bagels
places.notes: Saved POI
places.famousFor: Modern all-day brunch spot; everything from classic breakfasts to Turkish breakfast
places.goodToKnow: About 2-min walk from Zurich main station; open daily 9am-5pm, first-come no reservations, meat is halal

places.name: Babu's
places.order: Eggs Florentine; loaded bagels; carrot cake or banana bread
places.notes: Saved POI
places.famousFor: Bakery & coffeehouse with everything baked fresh in-house; popular weekend brunch
places.goodToKnow: Three Zurich locations; weekend brunch gets very busy, reservations highly recommended

places.name: Bros Beans & Beats
places.order: Specialty filter/espresso coffee; cheesecake; weekend brunch
places.notes: Saved POI
places.famousFor: Specialty coffee cafe with a relaxed, music-driven vibe; weekend brunch
places.goodToKnow: Open since 2016; weekdays 8am-8pm, weekends 10am-6pm with brunch and beats

places.name: John Baker Helvetiaplatz
places.near: Tram 8 to Helvetiaplatz, on the square
places.order: Butter Gipfeli or Plunder; a sourdough loaf; coffee; Bircher-style breakfast plates
places.notes: Source: zuerich.com John Baker Helvetiaplatz + johnbaker.ch
places.famousFor: Zürich's modern organic bakery: everything homemade from sustainably sourced flour, famous Plunder pastries and sourdough, specialty coffee (Beshasha Arabica); shares the old Credit Suisse building with BANK
places.goodToKnow: Mon-Fri 07:00-19:00, Sat 08:00-16:00, SUN 08:00-14:00 (open Sunday - the Stadelhofen branch is closed Sundays). Counter service; bakery items vegetarian

places.name: Bäckerei Kleiner - Zürich HB (ShopVille)
places.near: Underground level of Zürich HB (ShopVille)
places.order: Butter Gipfeli, Zopf slice, coffee; take a Nussgipfel for the train
places.notes: Source: sbb.ch ShopVille shop listing
places.famousFor: Reliable Zürich family bakery inside the main-station ShopVille: Gipfeli, Zopf, sandwiches and coffee 365 days a year - the safe Sunday/early-morning breakfast before a day trip
places.goodToKnow: Open 365 days: Mon-Fri 06:00-21:00, Sat-Sun 07:00-20:00. Quick counter breakfast; many other Kleiner branches around town · Location needs verification

places.name: Bäckerei Vohdin
places.near: 3-min walk from Bellevue up Oberdorfstrasse
places.order: Butterbrezel; amaretti; Zopf for a hotel-room breakfast; apple doughnut
places.notes: Source: hellozurich.ch + NZZ 400-years feature via search
places.famousFor: Possibly the smallest and oldest bakery in Zürich - ovens going at this address since 1626, family-run since 1895, sold through a tiny 4.3 m² window; Butterbrezeln from an ancestral recipe, amaretti, apple doughnuts and Zopf
places.goodToKnow: Tue-Fri 07:30-18:00 only; CLOSED Sat, Sun and Mon. No seating - takeaway window; cash only (CHF/EUR)

places.name: BANK Zürich
places.near: Tram 8 to Helvetiaplatz
places.order: Weekend brunch: build-your-own plate with John Baker bread, eggs, hummus, labneh-style dips; weekday breakfast until 11:00
places.notes: Source: zueriplausch.ch brunch list + bankzuerich.ch / wheretobrunch.ch
places.famousFor: Former bank hall on Helvetiaplatz turned all-day restaurant, café and bakery (with John Baker bread); build-your-own weekend brunch with Oriental-Mediterranean sharing plates
places.goodToKnow: Weekday breakfast until 11:00; Sat & Sun brunch 09:00-15:00 (open Sunday). Lively; book for 7. Bar in the evening - go for brunch

places.name: Bebek
places.near: Tram 8 or 9/14 to Kalkbreite/Bahnhof Wiedikon
places.order: The large Oriental breakfast platter to share; menemen; Turkish coffee; Sunday breakfast à discretion
places.notes: Source: zuerich.com Bebek page + zueriplausch.ch brunch list
places.famousFor: All-day Oriental breakfast in the Kalkbreite cooperative building (same block as Kino Houdini): big breakfast-and-meze platter, menemen, Turkish coffee; unique interior, always full
places.goodToKnow: Mon-Thu 08:00-24:00, Fri 08:00-01:00, Sat 09:00-01:00, Sun 09:00-22:00 (breakfast all week; Sunday breakfast buffet). Halal not stated - ask; plenty of vegetarian meze. Book ahead

places.name: Gül Restoran
places.near: Tram 8 to Helvetiaplatz or 2/3 to Kalkbreite, 4-min walk
places.order: The Turkish brunch spread; menemen; simit with kaymak and honey; Iskender chicken if you stay for lunch
places.notes: Source: gaultmillau.ch 'Türkisches Frühstück im Gül' + guel.ch hours
places.famousFor: Elif Oskan's acclaimed Turkish restaurant hidden in a courtyard: weekend Turkish breakfast with grilled peppers, egg dishes, oven-fresh ekmek, simit and pide from the wood oven, kaymak, olives and homemade jams; charcoal grill (ocakbaşı) at night
places.goodToKnow: Brunch Sat 11:00-13:00 and Sun 11:00-14:00 only (open Sunday); reservation essential. Halal not stated - ask; many vegetarian plates

places.name: Café des Amis
places.near: Tram 4/13 to Rosengartenstrasse or bus 32/46 Nordstrasse
places.order: Weekend brunch menu; sandwich on house bread with smoked salmon and guacamole; café crème
places.notes: Source: timeout.com Zurich brunch guide + desamis.ch hours
places.famousFor: One of the most popular Sunday brunches in town: French bistro feel, cute interiors, lovely garden terrace and French/Oriental-inspired breakfast plates
places.goodToKnow: Sun 09:00-18:00 (open Sunday); weekend brunch very busy - book online (up to 6) or email for 7+

places.name: Lake Side Sunday Brunch
places.cuisine: Sunday brunch buffet with lake view
places.near: S-Bahn or tram 2/4 to Tiefenbrunnen, 5-min walk along the lake
places.order: Sunday buffet: eggs, breads, Bircher, sushi, desserts; take a table on the lake side
places.notes: Source: wheretobrunch.ch Lake Side + zuerich.com
places.famousFor: Lakeside restaurant by Strandbad Tiefenbrunnen with a wide Sunday buffet (fresh breakfast items, mains, sushi, desserts) and a wonderful view over Lake Zürich
places.goodToKnow: Sunday only 11:00-14:30; CHF 69 adult, children up to 16 pay CHF 2.90 per year of age. Welcome prosecco included - decline it; buffet contains pork cold cuts, but eggs/fish/veg plentiful. Reserve

places.name: UTO KULM Sunday Brunch
places.cuisine: Sunday brunch buffet with city/Alps view
places.near: S10 from Zürich HB to Uetliberg (~20 min), then 10-min walk up
places.order: The buffet plus the chocolate fountain for the kids; walk up to the lookout tower afterwards
places.notes: Source: utokulm.ch Sonntagsbrunch page via search
places.famousFor: Brunch at the top of Zürich's house mountain: bread varieties, jams, cereals, cold cuts, salads, warm dishes, dessert buffet and a chocolate fountain, with the panorama over the city, lake and Alps
places.goodToKnow: Sunday 11:00-14:00; CHF 75 adult, 12-15 yrs CHF 50, 6-11 CHF 35, 3-5 CHF 19; includes breakfast drinks and a glass of prosecco (decline). Buffet has pork items; lots of vegetarian/eggs. Book ahead; combine with the Uetliberg outing

places.name: Gasthaus Albisgütli Sunday Brunch
places.near: Tram 13 to Albisgütli terminus (~15 min from HB)
places.order: Buffet: Zopf with jams, Älplermagronen, eggs; let the kids loose on the playground
places.notes: Source: albisguetli.ch / kinderregion.ch via search
places.famousFor: Huge Swiss brunch buffet in a country-style Gasthaus at the Uetliberg foot: oven-fresh breads, jams, cheese, egg dishes, Älplermagronen and desserts; big playground outside, play corner inside and a colouring book for kids
places.goodToKnow: Sunday 09:30-13:00; CHF 49.50 incl. all coffee drinks + welcome prosecco/Rimuss (non-alcoholic Rimuss available); kids to 2 free, 3-12 yrs CHF 1.90 per year of age. Buffet includes pork cold cuts. Reserve

places.name: Café Hubertus (Buchmann)
places.near: Tram 2/3 to Albisriederplatz
places.order: All-day breakfast plate; weekend brunch buffet; Buchmann Gipfeli
places.notes: Source: zuerich.com Café Hubertus + walterbuchmann.ch
places.famousFor: Family bakery Walter Buchmann's neighbourhood café: breakfast all day, breads straight from the bakery, and a weekend brunch buffet served from an old bread cart
places.goodToKnow: Mon-Sat 07:00-17:00, Sun 08:00-17:00 (open Sunday). Weekend brunch buffet; relaxed, local, good value

places.name: DRAFT. Coffee
places.near: Tram 2/4 to Feldeggstrasse, 3-min walk
places.order: Brunch plate (Thu-Sun); matcha latte or flat white; pastries
places.notes: Source: draftcoffee.ch + zuerich.com Draft. Coffee page
places.famousFor: Bright, design-led Seefeld coffee shop and weekend brunch spot: specialty coffee, matcha and other non-alcoholic 'functional' drinks, creative brunch with many plant-based options
places.goodToKnow: Sun 08:30-16:00 (open Sunday); brunch Thu-Sun until 14:30; no reservations - first come, first served (arrive early with 7). Alcohol-free concept

places.name: Café Irma
places.near: Tram 2/3 to Kalkbreite or 9/14 to Zurlindenstrasse
places.order: Sourdough brunch plate; brioche; kimchi toast; oat/pea-milk flat white
places.notes: Source: NZZ Bellevue '5 neue Adressen' + harrysding.ch / irma.zuerich hours
places.famousFor: 2025 opening devoted to house sourdough: brioche, kimchi toast and brunch built around the bread; cow-milk-free (pea/plant milks only) - a hit with Zürich brunch fans
places.goodToKnow: Thu-Sun 09:00-16:00 only (open Sunday), closed Mon-Wed. No reservations. No dairy cow milk on site

places.name: Zum guten Glück
places.near: Tram 9/14 or S-Bahn to Bahnhof Wiedikon, 2-min walk
places.order: Omelette or eggs plate; vegan breakfast; brunch on weekends from 09:00
places.notes: Source: zumgutenglueck.ch via search + zuerich.com
places.famousFor: Insider favourite among young Zürchers: big breakfast card with egg dishes, omelettes and vegan breakfasts served every day until 16:00; small guesthouse upstairs
places.goodToKnow: Open daily; Sun 09:00-20:00 with kitchen to 16:00 (open Sunday). Breakfast/brunch all week until 16:00 - useful for late risers

places.name: Café Kornsilo (Mühle Tiefenbrunnen)
places.near: S-Bahn or tram 2/4 to Tiefenbrunnen, 3-min walk
places.order: Weekend brunch (granola, Zopf, cheese/meat platter, crêpes); weekday breakfast 08:00-11:00
places.notes: Source: en.kornsilo.ch + zueriplausch.ch brunch list (kids' play area)
places.famousFor: Café in the former grain silo of the historic Tiefenbrunnen mill (same complex as the Mühlerama museum): fresh bread, homemade Mühlerama granola, crêpes, quiches and platters in a cosy courtyard; family-friendly with a kids' play corner
places.goodToKnow: Mon-Fri 08:00-16:30, Sat-Sun 09:00-16:30 (open Sunday); brunch Sat-Sun 09:00-14:30. Pairs with the Mühlerama museum for kids

places.name: Zürich Marriott Sunday Brunch
places.near: 10-min walk from Zürich HB along the river; tram 11/14 to Beckenhof
places.order: The buffet: breakfast station, sushi, Thai dishes, desserts; drop the kids in the playroom

places.name: Bar Butter

places.name: Omnia Coffee (Ombak)

places.name: Lamassu Specialty Coffee

places.notes: Source: thewaytocoffee.com + zuri.net / europeancoffeetrip hours

places.goodToKnow: Mon-Fri 07:00-16:00, Sat 09:00-16:30, Sun CLOSED. Takeaway-focused, few seats

places.name: Collective Bakery

places.order: Double-baked croissant; sourdough loaf to take back to the hotel; flat white
places.notes: Source: newinzurich.com guide + zuerich.com / Tripadvisor hours
places.famousFor: Zürich-West's cult sourdough bakery: double-baked croissants, pains au chocolat, changing specials and coffee roasted in-house; weekend queues
places.goodToKnow: Sun 09:00-16:00 (open weekends - expect a queue at opening). Bakery counter plus a few seats

places.name: Café Henrici

places.order: Latte or cappuccino; Parisian croissant with homemade jam; açai bowl; oven-baked eggs
places.notes: Source: newinzurich.com guide + hellozurich.ch / Yelp hours
places.famousFor: Family-run since 2009, inspired by San Francisco coffee culture; at the very start of Niederdorfstrasse - prime people-watching; Sunday brunch
places.goodToKnow: Open daily; Sun 09:00-22:00 with brunch. Vegan pizza and salads later in the day

places.name: Milchbar
