places.famousFor: The 1885 bridge where the lake becomes the Limmat: from its middle you get both Münster towers and the Old Town skyline in one frame upstream, and the full lake with the snow-Alps (Föhn days) downstream - Zürich's sunset spot
places.goodToKnow: Free, anytime. Sunset in mid-October ~18:30; the Alps show clearest after rain or on Föhn days. Swans and coots congregate at the Bürkliplatz corner - buy no bread (fines), just photos. Christmas lights on Bahnhofstrasse start late November, not October. · Kids: Wide pavement; swans below

places.name: Rathausbrücke (Gemüsebrücke) & Town Hall Facade
places.near: Tram 4/15 to Rathaus; walk from Bahnhofstrasse via Weinplatz
places.notes: en.wikipedia Rathausbrücke, Zurich (coords + Gmüesbrugg history)
places.famousFor: The wide 'vegetable bridge' square over the Limmat: the 1698 Rathaus rising straight out of the river, the Schipfe houses and Lindenhof on one side, Grossmünster towers on the other - the most photographed river frame in the Old Town
places.goodToKnow: Free, pedestrian zone, hosts small markets and festivals. Morning light hits the Rathaus facade; shoot the Schipfe side in the afternoon. The Limmat cruise boats pass right underneath - wave to the kids on board. · Kids: Car-free square; ice cream nearby

places.name: Sechseläutenplatz & Opera House
places.near: Tram 2/4/5/8/9/11/15 to Bellevue or Opernhaus; Parkhaus Opéra directly underneath (underground - check the 2.0 m sign before taking the van in)
places.notes: en.wikipedia Sechseläutenplatz (coords) + landezine design page
places.famousFor: Zürich's largest square (16,000 m² of Vals quartzite) fronting the neo-baroque Opera House and the lake: kids chase the pavement fountains, the Opera facade glows at dusk, and in October the leaves of the Bellevue plane trees frame it
places.goodToKnow: Free, always open. Hosts the Zürich autumn fair/circus Knie in some years and Christmas market from late Nov. Sprüngli, Café Odeon and Santa Lucia pizzeria are on the square's edge. From here walk the Utoquai promenade to Zürichhorn (25 min). · Kids: Huge car-free square; fountains

places.name: Holzbrücke Rapperswil-Hurden (Wooden Bridge across the Lake)
places.near: Starts behind Rapperswil station / Kinderzoo, ends in Hurden (SZ); walk one way (15 min) and back, or continue to Hurden's lakeside restaurants
places.notes: en.wikipedia Holzbrücke Rapperswil-Hurden (coords, facts) + zuerich.com
places.famousFor: Switzerland's longest wooden footbridge (841 m, 2001, on 233 oak piles) crossing Lake Zurich at its narrowest point, past the 1551 Heilig Hüsli chapel that stands alone on a rock in the water - leading-line photo heaven at sunset
places.goodToKnow: Free, 24/7, stroller-friendly, no cars (separate from the Seedamm road). Windy - jackets in October. Best shots: low sun across the planks toward the castle; swans and the Glarus Alps on clear days. Part of the pilgrim Way of St James. · Kids: Flat 15-min walk; railings

places.name: Rapperswil Harbour & Fischmarktplatz
places.near: 3 min walk from Rapperswil station; by car park at Parkhaus Seedamm-Center or the P by the station and walk; by boat from Zürich Bürkliplatz (~2 h, until mid-Oct)
places.notes: zuerich.com Rapperswil page (fetched 2026-09, tourist office at Fischmarktplatz 1) + tour-switzerland.ch Rapperswil guide
places.famousFor: The Rosenstadt's harbour square where the ZSG paddle steamers dock beneath the castle: lakeside cafés, the medieval Curti and Fischmarkt houses, the castle and Capuchin monastery towering above - the money shot of Rapperswil is from the end of the pier looking back
places.goodToKnow: Free. Tourist office (Rapperswil Zürichsee Tourismus) is right on the square for castle tickets. Afternoon light on the castle face; sunset from the Seequai. Rapperswil's shops and Saturday market are a few steps up Hauptplatz. · Kids: Boats, swans, gelato on the quay

places.name: Känzeli Rock Balcony (Rhine Falls, Schloss Laufen side)
places.area: Schloss Laufen / Dachsen, south bank of the Rhine Falls
places.near: Car ~45 min from Zürich via A4 to Dachsen/Schloss Laufen, car parks by the castle (cars up to 2.90 m CHF 5 first hour + CHF 2/h); train to 'Schloss Laufen am Rheinfall' station right at the castle
places.notes: schlosslaufen.ch experiences + myswitzerland Castle Laufen + rheinfall.ch parking (web search/fetch 2026-09); coords en.wikipedia Laufen Castle
places.famousFor: The rock platform that juts out INTO the falls - 23 m of water thundering past at arm's length - reached by the Belvedere trail steps below Laufen Castle; the glass panorama lift and the Belvedere platform give the stroller-friendly wide view
places.goodToKnow: Castle-side entry CHF 5 (kids 6-16 CHF 3.50, under 6 free) covers Belvedere, Känzeli, Fischetz platforms, the glass lift and the Historama. Känzeli and Fischetz are stairs-only; Belvedere is lift/stroller accessible. Wear a rain jacket - you get wet. Free ferry alternative: CHF 6 boat across to the Wörth side. Morning light is on the falls from this bank. · Kids: Steps + spray; 6+ hold hands

places.name: Madni Masjid Zürich (Swiss Muslim Society)
places.near: Tram 7/15 along Weinbergstrasse; about 10 min from Zürich HB
places.notes: masjid.ch + islammessage.org + masjidway.com
places.famousFor: Sunni mosque established 1996 by the Swiss Muslim Society for Muslims in Zürich city; five daily prayers and Jumu'ah, one of the best-rated mosques in town (4.8/5)
places.goodToKnow: Phone +41 43 810 03 79; South-Asian-led community, English/Urdu spoken; check masjid.ch for Jumu'ah time; street parking is tight — use tram

places.name: Zayed Moschee — Stiftung Islamische Gemeinschaft Zürich (Zaid Islamic Centre)
places.near: Bus 32 or tram 11/14 toward Oerlikon (Milchbuck / Berninaplatz area); ~10 min from HB
places.notes: de.islam-zh.ch (Friday schedule 2026) + zabihah.com
places.famousFor: Arabic-speaking Sunni foundation's main mosque (Zayed/Zaid Moschee) — Friday khutba at 14:30 per the 2026 schedule, full daily prayers, Arabic-language services
places.goodToKnow: Tel 044 363 52 10; the foundation runs a second Friday-prayer hall 'Binz Saal' at Üetlibergstrasse 54 (khutba 13:15); closest large Arabic mosque to the Oerlikon/Seebach side

places.name: İsviçre İslam Toplumu Zürih — Külliye Mosque
places.near: 5-min walk from Zürich HB along Sihlquai/Ausstellungsstrasse; tram 4/13/17 to Museum für Gestaltung
places.notes: zabihah.com + 2pos.ch listing (Ausstellungsstrasse 21)
places.famousFor: Zürich's oldest mosque, run by the Turkish-Swiss Islamic community (HGT), on level 3 of a building 5 minutes' walk from the main station — the handiest prayer stop while sightseeing
places.goodToKnow: Sunni (Hanafi/Turkish); enter and take the lift/stairs to level 3; phone +41 44 272 08 26; women's area available

places.name: Haus des Friedens (Albanian Mosque Schwamendingen)
places.near: Tram 7/9 or bus to Schwamendingerplatz; by van ~10 min from Seebach via Überlandstrasse
places.notes: hausdesfriedens.ch + zabihah.com
places.famousFor: Albanian-community Sunni mosque and cultural centre (since 2004, at Saatlenstrasse since 2013) in Schwamendingen — the nearest full mosque to the Seebach/Oerlikon/Kloten lodging zone
places.goodToKnow: Albanian/German spoken; Jumu'ah well attended — arrive early; note the Mahmud Mosque on Forchstrasse is Ahmadiyya, not Sunni

places.name: Stiftung der Islamischen Jugend — Seebach Mosque
places.near: Tram 10/14 or S-Bahn to Zürich Seebach, then short walk on Seebacherstrasse
places.notes: search.ch + esalah.com + VIOZ member list
places.famousFor: The mosque actually inside Seebach — VIOZ-member Islamic youth foundation with daily prayers and Jumu'ah, walking distance from Seebach station and the northern hotels
places.goodToKnow: Tel 043 300 16 70; a second small Seebach prayer space 'Freunde der Sunnah' is at Köschenrütistrasse 6 (8052); confirm Jumu'ah time by phone

places.name: Al Hidaya Verein & Moschee
places.near: 10-min walk from Zürich HB via Sihlquai/Limmatstrasse; tram 4/13/17 Limmatplatz
places.notes: readymap.ch + masjidway.com
places.famousFor: Sunni mosque of the Al Hidaya association (Forum des Orients) a few minutes north-west of the main station — a second central option for daily prayers
places.goodToKnow: Tel +41 44 730 30 11; Arabic-speaking; check prayer times on masjidway.com

places.name: Zurich Airport Prayer Rooms (Check-in 2 & Gate D)
places.near: Check-in 2 is in the main terminal, reachable from the Airport Center/railway station on foot
places.notes: islam.ch + baublatt.ch + airportchapel.de/en/zrh-2
places.famousFor: Two quiet prayer spaces: a landside interreligious 'Raum der Stille' in Check-in 2 (left, just past the passage to the observation deck) and an airside prayer room at Gate D, 1st floor (non-Schengen) next to the Transit Hotel
places.goodToKnow: Landside room is open to everyone incl. non-passengers; airside room only after security; wudu in nearby WCs; airport chaplaincy (Flughafenpfarramt) manages both · Location needs verification
places.address: Flughafen Zürich, Check-in 2 (landside) / Gate D 1st floor (airside), 8058 Zürich-Flughafen

places.name: Migros Zürich Airport (Airport Center)
places.near: Drive to the airport car parks (P1-P3) or S-Bahn/tram 10 to Zürich Flughafen; in the Airport Center shopping level
places.notes: flughafen-zuerich.ch shop listing + openhours.ch
places.famousFor: Full Migros supermarket in the Airport Center open every day of the year 06:00-23:00 — the go-to Sunday and late-night grocery run from Seebach/Kloten
places.goodToKnow: Mon-Sun 06:00-23:00; Migros sells no alcohol/tobacco; short-term parking cheapest in P3/Parkhaus with the first 30-60 min tariff — check signage · Location needs verification

places.name: ShopVille Zürich HB — Coop & Migros (Sunday shopping)
places.near: Inside Zürich HB, levels -1 and -2 (Halle Löwenstrasse / Landesmuseum)
places.notes: sbb.ch ShopVille + coop.ch + filialen.migros.ch
places.famousFor: The station's 365-day shopping mall: Coop ShopVille HB and Migros 'ShopVilleMärt' both open Sundays 08:00-22:00, plus ~190 shops (Läderach, Bachmann, pharmacies, SIM shops) when the rest of Switzerland is closed
places.goodToKnow: Migros Mon-Fri 06:30-22:00, Sat-Sun 08:00-22:00; Coop Sun 08:00-22:00; the only reliable Sunday shopping in central Zürich apart from Bahnhof Stadelhofen/Enge station shops · Location needs verification

places.name: Migros Seebach
places.near: Tram 10/14 to Seebacherplatz; free short-stay customer parking usually available
places.notes: search.ch + filialen.migros.ch + coop-pronto.ch
places.famousFor: Nearest full-size Migros to the Seebach/airport hotels, at Seebacherplatz — groceries, fresh bread, baby items, Migros Restaurant-style takeaway
places.goodToKnow: Closed Sundays — use Migros Airport or Coop Pronto Oerlikon Bahnhof (Hofwiesenstrasse 369, daily 05:30-23:45) on Sunday; in Kloten: Migros Schaffhauserstrasse 122 and Coop Kloten Center Schaffhauserstrasse 146 (Mon-Sat)

places.name: Halk Pazari — Halal Market, Butcher & Bakery Oerlikon
places.near: Tram 10/14 or bus to Oerlikon; 5 min from Bahnhof Oerlikon; street parking on Tramstrasse
places.notes: halkpazari.ch + oeffnungszeitenbuch.de + GaultMillau
places.famousFor: Family-run Turkish/oriental halal supermarket with its own halal butcher counter, bakery (pide, gözleme, lahmacun) and restaurant — the best halal one-stop shop near Seebach/airport
places.goodToKnow: Mon-Sat 08:00-22:00, Sunday closed; tel 044 310 39 66; GaultMillau-praised fresh flatbreads from the oven

places.name: Ege Supermarkt & Restaurant (Langstrasse quarter)
places.near: Tram 8 to Helvetiaplatz or tram 3 to Bäckeranlage; 10 min from Stauffacher
places.notes: Tripadvisor + zabihah.com; Neiger via zuri.net/Yelp
places.famousFor: Switzerland's first Turkish market — halal meat counter, Turkish groceries and a canteen-style restaurant with daily halal menus; the Langstrasse area also has the city's densest cluster of halal eateries
places.goodToKnow: Tel +41 44 271 80 30; another cheap, popular halal butcher nearby is Neiger Fleisch, Josefstrasse 137, 8005 (tel 043 366 98 50)

places.name: Bellevue Apotheke (24h pharmacy)
places.near: Tram 2/4/5/8/9/11/15 to Bellevue; on Theaterstrasse opposite the Opera side
places.notes: bazh.ch + search.ch
places.famousFor: Zürich's round-the-clock pharmacy since 1976 on Bellevue square — open 24 hours, 365 days, with pharmacists for children's fever, allergies, travel needs
places.goodToKnow: Tel 044 266 62 22; CHF 10 night surcharge between 00:00 and 06:00; nearest garage Parkhaus Opéra (2.10 m)

places.name: Amavita Apotheke Flughafen Zürich
places.near: Airport Center / Airport Shopping landside, next to the train station level
places.notes: flughafen-zuerich.ch + amavita.ch + airportmedicalcenter.ch
places.famousFor: Airport pharmacy in the public Airport Shopping area, open daily 07:00-21:00 with a multilingual team; medicines, baby needs, travel vaccinations and health checks
places.goodToKnow: Tel +41 58 878 25 60; a second Amavita is airside in the Airside Center 06:00-22:00; for a doctor the Airport Medical Center is in Prime Center 1, 8th floor (Arrival 1), 365 days 07:30-19:00 for emergencies by appointment · Location needs verification

places.name: Bahnhof Apotheke Oerlikon
places.near: S-Bahn or tram 10/14 to Bahnhof Oerlikon; level -1 passage
places.notes: sbb.ch station shop listing + achillea.ch
places.famousFor: Pharmacy inside Oerlikon station open 365 days 07:00-22:00 — the late/Sunday pharmacy for the Seebach-Oerlikon side; Coop Pronto next door for basics
places.goodToKnow: Tel 044 364 44 44; Oerlikon is 5 min from Seebach by tram 10/14 and one S-Bahn stop from the airport

places.name: Kinderspital Zürich — Children's Emergency (Notfall)
places.near: Bus 31/33 or tram 11 toward Lengg/Balgrist; emergency entrance Lenggstrasse 30 with underground drop-off; ~20 min by van from Seebach via the city
places.notes: kispi.uzh.ch Notfall + emergency-entrance PDF
places.famousFor: Switzerland's largest children's hospital, in its new Herzog & de Meuron building since Nov 2024 — 24/7 paediatric emergency department plus a walk-in emergency practice for minor illnesses/injuries
places.goodToKnow: Emergency 144; Medgate Kids Line 058 387 78 80 for advice; bring passports and travel insurance; for adults, Ärztefon 0800 33 66 55 (24h medical hotline for canton Zürich)

places.name: Universitätsspital Zürich — Notfallzentrum (Adult ER)
places.near: Tram 6/9/10 to ETH/Universitätsspital or tram 5/6/9 to Platte; emergency entrance on Schmelzbergstrasse
places.notes: usz.ch/notfall + gesundheitsregion.zuerich
places.famousFor: The university hospital's 24-hour emergency centre for adults — full trauma, cardiac and specialist cover; the reference ER in the city
places.goodToKnow: Main line +41 44 255 11 11; ambulance 144; non-urgent: Ärztefon 0800 33 66 55 (24h) will route you to a duty doctor or Permanence; children go to Kinderspital instead

places.name: Parkhaus Urania
places.near: Follow the Parkleitsystem signs for 'Urania'; entry on Uraniastrasse; 24/7
places.notes: parkhaus-urania.ch + parkleitsystem.ch + coparking.ch (HB height)
places.famousFor: Largest central garage (607 spaces) with a 2.10 m entry height — the practical spot to leave a 9-seat van for Bahnhofstrasse, Lindenhof, Old Town and the Limmatquai
places.goodToKnow: Max height 2.10 m — measure the van incl. roof rails; from CHF 2.00/30 min, daily flat rate available; the Parkhaus Hauptbahnhof (Sihlquai 41) is only 2.00-2.05 m — too low for most high-roof vans

places.name: Parkhaus Opéra
places.near: Entrance Schillerstrasse 5 by the Opera House; follow 'Opéra' on the Parkleitsystem
places.notes: parkhaus-opera.ch + pls-zh.ch + parkopedia
places.famousFor: Central lakeside garage under Sechseläutenplatz with 2.10 m entry height — 299 spaces, ideal for Bellevue, the lake promenade, Zürichhorn walk, Kronenhalle area and the 24h Bellevue pharmacy
places.goodToKnow: 24/7; tel +41 44 266 85 20; height limit 2.10 m; accessible bays and EV charging

places.name: P+Rail Zürich Seebach
places.near: Bahnhaldenstrasse beside Bahnhof Zürich Seebach; then S6/S16 or tram 10/14 to HB
places.notes: parking.ch + parkopedia + sbb.ch P+Rail
places.famousFor: SBB Park+Rail lot at Seebach station — leave the van here and take the S-Bahn/tram 14 into Zürich HB in ~10 min instead of hunting for city garages
places.goodToKnow: Pay by SBB app/P+Rail ticket (hourly or day ticket); can fill on weekdays — Sundays are easy; alternative Zürich-Nord option: Parkhaus Messe Zürich at Oerlikon with tram 10/14/11 to HB

places.name: ZRH Rental Car Return — Parking 3 (P3)
places.near: From the A51 airport exit follow 'Departure / Rental Car Return' to P3; Sixt returns on P3 level 2
places.notes: flughafen-zuerich.ch car-hire + Hertz return guide + ch.ch vignette
places.famousFor: All airport rental returns (Sixt, Hertz, Europcar, Avis, Enterprise/National/Alamo) go into car park P3 — follow the 'Abflug / Rental Car Return' signs; key drop boxes for after-hours
places.goodToKnow: Swiss motorway vignette 2026 = CHF 40 (annual, sticker or e-vignette, valid 1 Dec 2025-31 Jan 2027) — Swiss-registered rental vans normally include it, but confirm at pickup; leave a copy of the contract with the keys; allow 15 min for the walk to check-in

places.name: Sunrise & Swisscom Shops — Zürich HB (tourist SIM)
places.near: Inside Zürich HB: Sunrise level -1; Swisscom at Bahnhofplatz 15 (Halle Bahnhofplatz)
places.notes: sbb.ch shop listings + swisscomshops.swisscom.ch
places.famousFor: Both Swiss carriers have station shops open 365 days (Mon-Fri 09:00-21:00, Sat-Sun 09:00-20:00): Sunrise on level -1 of ShopVille, Swisscom in the Bahnhofplatz hall — buy prepaid tourist SIM/eSIM with passport
places.goodToKnow: Passport required for prepaid activation; Salt is also in ShopVille; kiosks (k kiosk) sell prepaid starter packs; Swisscom has the best rural/alpine coverage for day trips · Location needs verification
places.address: Bahnhofplatz 15 / ShopVille level -1, Zürich HB, 8001 Zürich

places.name: Tourist Information Zürich (HB main hall)
places.near: Ground floor of Zürich HB in the main concourse
places.notes: sbb.ch + zuerich.com
places.famousFor: Zürich Tourism's office in the station hall — Zürich Card, maps, ZVV tickets advice, tour and excursion bookings; barrier-free and open 365 days
places.goodToKnow: Mon-Sat 08:00-21:00, Sun 09:00-19:00; ask about the Zürich Card (free public transport + museums) for the family · Location needs verification

places.name: SBB Luggage Lockers & Left-Luggage Counter — Zürich HB
places.near: Level -1 of Zürich HB; counter at the SBB Reisezentrum area
places.notes: sbb.ch locker + luggage-deposit listings
places.famousFor: Self-service lockers (level -1, follow the blue 'Schliessfächer/Lockers' signs; 24h rental, max 72h) plus a staffed counter for oversized bags and strollers — useful for a luggage-free last day
places.goodToKnow: Lockers Mon-Fri 04:15-01:15, Sat-Sun all day; staffed counter Mon-Fri 08:00-19:00, Sat-Sun 09:00-18:00, roughly CHF 6-16 per item/24h; the airport also has SBB lockers in Airport Shopping

places.name: Lea's Waschhaus Laundry Self-Service
places.near: Tram 2/3 to Lochergut or Kalkbreite; street parking limited — use blue-zone with disc
places.notes: Yelp + local.ch (Express Wäscherei)
places.famousFor: Well-reviewed self-service launderette in Kreis 4 — large-capacity machines and dryers for a family mid-trip wash; close to the Langstrasse halal food area
places.goodToKnow: Confirm hours before going; alternative nearer the university: Express Wäscherei Self-Service, Winterthurerstrasse 62, 8006 (Mon-Fri 07:00-22:00); many hotels near the airport also offer paid laundry
